This race is tight, and every contribution helps us reach more voters before Election Day. body:
We have the momentum. They have the money.

We need to level with you, Peter:
North Carolina’s U.S. Senate seat is not guaranteed to flip blue this November.
**We’re just one step away from being a toss-up race _at best_ – [_and without your help to reach our goal for tomorrow night’s FEC end-of-quarter deadline, that could change._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1284&amount=5&t=8&akid=3962%2E124072%2E14Gpwy)
The GOP knows the momentum is on our side. They also know Democrats can’t take back the majority without this seat. They’re willing to spend a lot of money to stop _both_ from happening.
They’re betting that over $100 million in attack ads and a few rallies headlined by MAGA’s top brass will be enough to drown out Roy Cooper’s message and erase our razor-thin lead.
Since two recent polls show the race is back down to a statistical tie, so far, it’s working.
Make no mistake – there’s plenty more where that came from to power Michael Whatley all the way into the lead. The GOP will not hesitate to spend it over these last five weeks if it can buy them two more years of one-party rule over the country.
It all depends on whether our final quarterly campaign finance report shows we have the grassroots strength to seriously compete.

subject: Donald Trump isn’t running for Governor. But he is on the ballot.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA]
body:
[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/13510?t=1001&akid=492%2E245147%2E81YS0- ][IMG]

Donald Trump isn’t running for Governor of Pennsylvania. But for all
intents and purposes, his name is on the ballot this November.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/13510?t=1002&akid=492%2E245147%2E81YS0- ]I’ll tell you what I mean by that in a moment, but things are urgent
right now at Shapiro HQ. We’re just one day out from our LAST
End-of-Quarter deadline before Election Day, and we’re racing to make up
ground before the far-right gets a good, long look at our latest
fundraising report. Can you spare a few bucks to help us fight back
against all the attacks coming our way — including from the president
himself?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/13511?t=1003&akid=492%2E245147%2E81YS0- ]Rush $15 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/13510?t=1004&akid=492%2E245147%2E81YS0- ]Other →

Believe it or not, there used to be daylight between someone running for
governor and the Republican national party in DC.

But those days? They feel like a distant memory right now. Instead, Donald
Trump has molded the party in his image – and purged anyone who dares to
disagree with him.

Now, people like my opponent aren’t running on their own record, or even
their own ideas! They’re running on Donald Trump’s — no matter how
disastrous and how harmful his policies are to working families.

If you know me, you know I don’t take marching orders from anyone. I’ll do
what’s right for Pennsylvania, every single time.

But these far-right politicians? If they take control of Pennsylvania,
they’ll have no original thoughts. No willingness to find solutions. If
they run into a problem, they’ll run directly to the White House and ask
their party boss — a guy who doesn’t understand the first thing about the
good people of Pennsylvania.

To put it another way: Far-right politicians want to turn Pennsylvania
into a mirror image of DC. More chaos. More cruelty. More corruption. And
they’re willing to spend whatever it takes to make it happen.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/13510?t=1005&akid=492%2E245147%2E81YS0- ]So Derek, if you
care about Pennsylvania’s future, please consider making a donation ahead
of tomorrow night’s huge deadline. Any amount you can give will help our
team push back against the far-right’s lies and build a government all
Pennsylvanians can be proud of.

The fact of the matter my husband bought and renewed US Treasury notes -- government securities that support America’s infrastructure and economy. They ARE NOT individual corporate stocks. These ads falsely suggest that I don’t support safeguards against unethical stock trading by members of Congress. As early as 2012, I co-sponsored the **Stop Trading on Congressional Knowledge Act** (STOCK Act). I also co-sponsored the **Restore Trust in Congress Act** in 2025 to ban members of Congress and their immediate families from owning or trading individual stocks. Instead of explaining why Mai accepted nearly $60,000 in corporate and business donations as a council member or why she’s missed nearly 50% of air quality and transportation board meetings, her monied supporters are spending hundreds of thousands of dollars to mislead voters about me. #### [DrewForNevada.com](https://us.list-manage.com/vSFaO3C6Z8E?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)

Peter -It’s been a busy few weeks on the campaign trail!I’ve spend the last few weeks traveling across Northern Nevada with Governor Joe Lombardo, Lieutenant Governor Stavros Anthony, and Controller Andy Matthews, making stops in Elko, Winnemucca, Lovelock, Carson City, and Reno.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/AxqO2UTYSXP?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)
| | | | | | | | | | | | Since then, I’ve kept the roads hot, with stops in Douglas and Nye counties for chamber meetings, fall festivals, and conversations with Nevadans about how I can make their lives a little easier as our next State Treasurer.
Back home in Las Vegas, I also had a great time at the Vietnamese American community’s Mid-Autumn Festival. I’ve attended the celebration several times over the years, but this may have been the best one yet. I appreciated the opportunity to speak to the crowd, share a little about my own travels in Vietnam, and spend time with a community I look forward to representing as Nevada’s next Treasurer.
---
| [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/vdaTBqlHPQp?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)
| | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/z7Ui5imXWRH?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)
| [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/fQls2sI0uwN?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)
| | | | | | | | | | | | One thing I hear everywhere I go is that people want their government to respect the money they work so hard to earn. Whether I’m talking with a small business owner, a retiree, or a family trying to keep up with rising costs, the message is remarkably similar: government needs to be more accountable, more responsible, and more focused on delivering value for taxpayers.

**I’m honored to have Sheriff Kevin McMahill’s support.**
Last week, I was proud to [**announce the endorsement of Clark County Sheriff Kevin McMahill.**](https://us.list-manage.com/NuMxnnUUr5K?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)
Sheriff McMahill understands that responsible financial management isn’t an abstract issue — it affects the services our communities rely on every day. In announcing his endorsement, he pointed to my commitment to fiscal discipline, accountability, and protecting Nevadans’ tax dollars. I’m grateful to have his trust and support as we work to bring those principles to the Treasurer’s Office.
---
| [Read Sheriff McMahill’s Endorsement](https://us.list-manage.com/jmbFzjnrYPW?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)
---
| | **A new idea to eventually eliminate Nevada’s state gas tax.**

I also recently [**unveiled one of the biggest policy proposals of our campaign**](https://us.list-manage.com/82ZxEvb1x_M?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d): a plan to eliminate Nevada’s 23-cent-per-gallon gas tax _without_ raising other taxes or cutting funding for roads.
It won’t happen overnight, but I believe Nevada has an opportunity to think bigger about how we manage our resources and lower costs for taxpayers.
---
| [Read My Proposal to Eliminate NV’s Gas Tax](https://us.list-manage.com/14jMQDPMPky?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)
---
| | **And now, we have an important deadline ahead.**
September 30 (that’s TOMORROW!) marks the end of the quarter — and it’s one of [**the most important fundraising deadlines of this campaign**](https://us.list-manage.com/PICL_A8iJjV?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d).
Every contribution we receive before midnight helps us demonstrate the strength behind this campaign and gives us the resources to keep traveling the state, communicating our message, and building the momentum we need to win.
I’m grateful for the support we’ve received from leaders and organizations across Nevada — but even more importantly, I’m grateful for the thousands of Nevadans who have taken the time to talk with me, share their concerns, and tell me what they want to see from their next State Treasurer.
If you believe Nevada deserves a Treasurer who will protect taxpayers, demand accountability, and make sure every dollar is managed responsibly, please [**consider making a contribution before the September 30 deadline**](https://us.list-manage.com/hpJBiJWSqQR?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d).
---
| [DONATE BEFORE SEPT. 30 @ MIDNIGHT!](https://us.list-manage.com/qWWI8Bsq1ZV?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)
---
| | Thank you for being part of this campaign. There are a lot more miles ahead, and I’m looking forward to seeing many more of you along the way.
In liberty,Drew

Peter, AI is advancing at a pace Washington cannot match. And the people building it are warning us about what could happen if we get this wrong. **We cannot afford to wait for a catastrophe before Congress acts. That’s why I’m introducing the **[**Human Control Over AI Act**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140230114/649938629/-1369921923?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMyMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjhkMWVjOTctMjViYy1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=KS7HhwgrCbCWGLMtQgnKOHcBqu4PWPQfLK9GHppvfYs=&emci=f861a654-24bc-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=b8d1ec97-25bc-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=9848080)**, a new bill to make sure artificial intelligence can’t act independently. ** Let me explain: As I told CNBC this week, the risk is not just that AI makes a mistake. It is that these increasingly capable systems could begin improving themselves, modifying their own objectives, or circumventing the safeguards designed to keep humans in control.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140230115/649938630/-1369921923?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMyMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjhkMWVjOTctMjViYy1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=KS7HhwgrCbCWGLMtQgnKOHcBqu4PWPQfLK9GHppvfYs=&emci=f861a654-24bc-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=b8d1ec97-25bc-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=9848080)

**We need comprehensive AI regulation. We cannot wait until we lose control to start building the guardrails.** My bill would: ✅ Ban recursive, self-improving AI until safeguards are in place
✅ Create a federal AI safety agency with licensing and oversight authority
✅ Require safety standards, including kill switches, containment, and secure testing environments
✅ Embed independent auditors at frontier AI labs who report directly to the agency
✅ Create criminal penalties for catastrophic AI harms and disabling critical safeguards
✅ Require AI companies to carry extensive liability insurance
✅ Pursue enforceable agreements with China and other adversaries to prevent dangerous AI development **[ADD YOUR NAME: Tell Congress to pass my Human Control Over AI Act.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140230116/649938631/1777170263?contactdata=4xyg4G77aWLn1aGJr5Tdd9JY8mZSecxtyhdRG2+FW7slqwrrIzXFE/pNko02+cddL2a09uXEPA0xB9gq7w2XmUUP1VjY/s39AsijCi9sUOlsfkWOH2YzGiDh6r9RQgO47e5wJdUScXQrvGf6j8NvsdGAWcqG/T0vqAHLLCXZ3IuHf9Ah756syT2c73650lMA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMyMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjhkMWVjOTctMjViYy1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=KS7HhwgrCbCWGLMtQgnKOHcBqu4PWPQfLK9GHppvfYs=&emci=f861a654-24bc-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&emdi=b8d1ec97-25bc-f111-a6a9-000d3a56d2f7&ceid=9848080)**

Right now, Congress is largely sitting on the sidelines while AI capabilities accelerate. That is unacceptable. We regulate technologies that can cause catastrophic harm. AI should be no different. We have a narrow window to get this right. **The question is not whether AI will transform our world; it already is. The question is whether we will put guardrails in place before the technology moves beyond our control.** I believe in the promise of AI. But I also believe it’s our responsibility to make sure it remains under human control. That is the standard we should demand. clean_body: We have one chance to get this right.| | | | Peter, AI is advancing at a pace Washington cannot match. And the people building it are warning us about what could happen if we get this wrong. We cannot afford to wait for a catastrophe before Congress acts. That’s why I’m introducing the , a new bill to make sure artificial intelligence can’t act independently. Let me explain: As I told CNBC this week, the risk is not just that AI makes a mistake. It is that these increasingly capable systems could begin improving themselves, modifying their own objectives, or circumventing the safeguards designed to keep humans in control. We need comprehensive AI regulation. We cannot wait until we lose control to start building the guardrails. My bill would: ✅ Ban recursive, self-improving AI until safeguards are in place ✅ Create a federal AI safety agency with licensing and oversight authority ✅ Require safety standards, including kill switches, containment, and secure testing environments ✅ Embed independent auditors at frontier AI labs who report directly to the agency ✅ Create criminal penalties for catastrophic AI harms and disabling critical safeguards ✅ Require AI companies to carry extensive liability insurance ✅ Pursue enforceable agreements with China and other adversaries to prevent dangerous AI development Right now, Congress is largely sitting on the sidelines while AI capabilities accelerate. That is unacceptable. We regulate technologies that can cause catastrophic harm. AI should be no different. We have a narrow window to get this right. The question is not whether AI will transform our world; it already is. The question is whether we will put guardrails in place before the technology moves beyond our control. I believe in the promise of AI. But I also believe it’s our responsibility to make sure it remains under human control. That is the standard we should demand. And that is why I’m introducing this bill. Thank you for your activism and all that you do. In solidarity, Ro | | | | | | | Wait! One more thing– Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. By donating just $3 today, you’re helping us create a country that works for everyone, not just those at the top. That means a renewed investment in American manufacturing, Medicare for All, student debt relief, and a green future. If you want to support our people-powered campaign as we continue to fight for progress in Washington, please consider making a donation of $3 or more today. _Let me lay this out, clear as day:_
I am the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won in 2024.
That makes me **MAGA 's #1 target.** They are going to do anything and everything to replace me with a MAGA puppet.
_If you 're outraged by what's happening to our country -- and you're ready to fight back -- please rush a contribution to my reelection campaign today._
**Here is the best link to donate** : **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ossoff-fr-substack-2026](https://substack.com/redirect/83121b69-01c8-4f41-8c48-385d29da36eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Across Georgia and across the country, a wave is building. People are looking at what's happening in this country and saying _" Enough is enough!"_
They look around and see our government made a tool of one man's vengeance, power, and wealth.
They see prices soar while the president rakes in billions.
They see our nation plunged deeper and deeper into another reckless war.
They see the Justice Department and even our intelligence agencies being twisted to serve this president's vendettas.
So yes, the situation is serious.
And now one of Trump's most fanatical allies in the House -- Mike Collins, a man who is himself awash in scandal -- wants to take this seat and become a Senator, where he can do vastly more damage.
_The GOP is going to spend a fortune to prop up Mike and flip my seat._
But remember: five years ago, we made history.
**We defeated an entrenched incumbent and flipped a Senate seat here in Georgia** -- _America 's most competitive battleground state._
That victory won control of the Senate.
Now I'm up for reelection.
And now, again, the path back from crisis runs through Georgia. Again, the entire nation is looking toward Georgia.
And now, again, I need you with me.
**[So, please: Rush a contribution to my campaign in Georgia today.](https://substack.com/redirect/83121b69-01c8-4f41-8c48-385d29da36eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thank you,
Jon

body:

Hi Peter, I know your inbox is packed right now. Election season will do that. So I'll get right to it. Our end-of-quarter FEC deadline hits tomorrow night, and we're still short of our goal. **[$3 from you could close the gap – can you chip in now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140231715/649943973/954579451?refcode=em-9.29.26-all-1-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMjFmZDI3NC0yN2JjLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=G9RYWxI-IsZoVU4Spqd_hk9dnAt5pa0_--X7bw6lrqI=)** If you're wondering why this deadline matters so much: it's our FINAL quarterly FEC deadline before Election Day, and the numbers we report will be public. It's one of the clearest signals of a campaign's strength heading into the final stretch. As a reminder, we're defending this seat for the first time in November, after a primary where our Republican opponent finished too close for comfort. Hey, it’s Mary Trump. I know my uncle better than most people would ever want to. And I can tell you what truly scares him. It’s not the courts or the investigations. What Donald fears most is _losing power_. He’s spent years trying to keep us divided and convinced that nothing we do matters. Because isolated people are easier to control. They’re less likely to organize, less likely to vote, less likely to show up. **And a country full of people who have given up is exactly the kind of country Donald wants to rule.** That’s why I’ve always admired the work of Jane Fonda and her team. Jane isn’t waiting around for Washington to suddenly find its courage. She and her team are helping elect brave leaders who are willing to stand up to my uncle, to the fossil fuel billionaires backing him, and to the extremists trying to drag this country backward. **They’ve already helped elect more than 250 climate champions — many in races that never make national headlines, but where the stakes could not be higher. That’s the kind of work that quietly chips away at Donald’s power.** **[And that’s the kind of work I’m asking you to be a part of. Jane’s Climate PAC set a goal of raising 2,500 individual donations before tomorrow at midnight to power these final 35 days of the midterms. And they’re counting on an uptick in donations from people in Cresco to get there. Don’t get me wrong, my uncle is the face of the horrors taking place, but behind him is an entire network of powerful interests and yes-men fighting to protect their own wealth and power.
They’ve stood by someone who is clearly deteriorating — psychologically, emotionally, and cognitively — because the status quo benefits them. Plain and simple.
Jane sees that danger just as clearly as I do. That’s why her team has already endorsed more than two hundred leaders this year, from utility boards all the way to Congress — including in places too many people have written off as “safely red”.

But if we wait until the fall to get serious, we’ll be playing catch-up against my uncle and the powerful interests already spending to keep people like him in power. The leaders who can actually beat his politics of cruelty need to be funded, organized, and ready now, not in October.**

clean_body: What Donald fears most is losing power. | Hey, it’s Mary Trump. I know my uncle better than most people would ever want to. And I can tell you what truly scares him. It’s not the courts or the investigations. What Donald fears most is losing power. He’s spent years trying to keep us divided and convinced that nothing we do matters. Because isolated people are easier to control. They’re less likely to organize, less likely to vote, less likely to show up. And a country full of people who have given up is exactly the kind of country Donald wants to rule. That’s why I’ve always admired the work of Jane Fonda and her team. Jane isn’t waiting around for Washington to suddenly find its courage. She and her team are helping elect brave leaders who are willing to stand up to my uncle, to the fossil fuel billionaires backing him, and to the extremists trying to drag this country backward. They’ve already helped elect more than 250 climate champions — many in races that never make national headlines, but where the stakes could not be higher. That’s the kind of work that quietly chips away at Donald’s power. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Don’t get me wrong, my uncle is the face of the horrors taking place, but behind him is an entire network of powerful interests and yes-men fighting to protect their own wealth and power. They’ve stood by someone who is clearly deteriorating — psychologically, emotionally, and cognitively — because the status quo benefits them. Plain and simple. Jane sees that danger just as clearly as I do. That’s why her team has already endorsed more than two hundred leaders this year, from utility boards all the way to Congress — including in places too many people have written off as “safely red”. These candidates refuse to bow down to bullies and corporate polluters. But if we wait until the fall to get serious, we’ll be playing catch-up against my uncle and the powerful interests already spending to keep people like him in power. _**Cliff 's Note:**_
##### I've been watching Susan Collins work her con since 2002, when I was a young campaign researcher in Portland, freezing my ass off and learning exactly how she does it: the concerned frown, the speech about how troubled she is, and then the vote that hands the other side everything it wanted.
##### This week, ProPublica put a new piece on the board: an FBI pay-to-play investigation that was circling her operation until Trump came back and it vanished. That's strike three. I lay out all three below, plus the 1996 dirty trick she opened her career with, and why Maine finally gets to call the game in November.

_**by Cliff Schecter**_
As the Boston Red Sox go to the playoffs today to face my beloved New York Yankees, baseball feels like an apt metaphor for New-England-based-Senator (though, her spine is stored down in Palm Beach), Susan Collins.
Baseball has a simple way to judge performance: three strikes, you're out. If you follow the sport, then you know many more players are striking out than in the game's past. The same is true with a plethora of politicians in our modern MAGA age. So when Collins began her political career by running for the U.S. Senate after Paul Revere began his midnight ride...wait, what's that? They're telling me she's _only_ been there 30 years.
Just feels like 200.
Maybe even more to me, as I moved up to Portland, ME in the fall of 2002, a young pup who post-9/11 wanted to get out of the the New York City/DC area, and gain experience in campaign research and communications. I worked for Chellie Pingree, now a Congresswoman, who was running against Collins. I worked with Hannah Pingree, likely to be Maine's next governor in a few months. And I encountered, a metric shite ton of snow, some great lobster, and a brew pub I still fondly remember, Gritty McDuff's, where one could tie one on with some locals.
A great experience overall, which allowed me to see how lucky we are to have the Pingree's in office (trust me, I have jokes with friends in the biz about never wanting to vote for the people we actually work for. Chellie is the real deal. So is Hannah.). But it also allowed me to see up close what an absolute snake Susan Collins is--and I had to see it long before her own voters and most of America caught on. And then watch her win again and again by pretending to be Maine Nice, when she's closer to Head Lice.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/42baba5e-827d-4b65-916a-a5e2446d5af6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Now to the point. The latest bombshell reporting about the untoward relationship between Collins' political operation and a sleazy defense contractor makes it worth looking back at the first two. Collins has tried for a third time to abscond with no damage from an ABSCAM. Sorry, Suse, but this time it ain't happening. Because, the truth is, her political operation has always been as corrupt as any other pol you can name or fill up with helium to animate, like current Mitch McConnell. She's just, cleverly, and corruptly camouflaged it behind a brand-borrowing, bumbling, ever-frowning persona.
Susan Collins is concerned, if you will.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b023315d-bdbd-49b1-9987-9c99ffc5a7a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### Strike One: "He Learned His Lesson"
When Donald Trump faced his first impeachment, Collins voted to acquit him. Her reassurance? "I hope that the president has learned the lesson." Uh huh. The five (or is it six?) bankruptcies, three marriages, fined $25MM for running a scam "university," exposed on tape saying he could grab women "by the p*ssy," (to quote Captain America, "I can do this all day"), and banned from ever running a foundation again in New York because he stole funds from:
> Army Emergency Relief, the Children's Aid Society, Citymeals-on-Wheels, Give an Hour, Martha's Table, the United Negro College Fund, the United Way of National Capital Area, and the U.S. Holocaust Memorial Museum.
Yeah, that's definitely the kinda guy who learns his lesson. Which he would later, predictably prove again by inspiring and funding the January 6th coup, being adjudicated a rapist by a judge, and becoming our first felon President. Found guilty on 34 counts of being criminally stupid, and easily being a bigger d*k than possessed by Michelangelo's statue of David. For trying to overturn the 2020 election he was impeached again. Collins voted to convict him that time, but with six other Republicans doing it she absolutely had to. And the simple truth is, _her first vote already told us what her warnings were worth_ : She could recognize the danger, deliver a concerned speech, and still let him walk.

Peter, It's Becca. **When I was growing up, I didn't know what kind of future was possible for someone like me. But I was gay. I knew that much.** What I didn't know was whether I could live openly, build a family, lead, or someday walk into rooms where decisions were being made and know I belonged there too. **I definitely never imagined I would become the first woman and first openly LGBTQ+ person Vermont ever sent to Congress.** That came up recently when I sat down with my friend Congressman George Whitesides for a very unofficial interview involving some extremely spicy chicken wings. 🤯 We laughed a lot, I suffered through some truly disrespectful hot sauce, and we got into some of the more personal parts of my story too. And underneath all the hot sauce and laughing was something I think about a lot. There are kids growing up right now asking some of the same questions I did. Can I be myself? Will I be safe? Will there be a place for me? Can I dream as big as everybody else? And I ALWAYS want their answer to be yes. Not because every LGBTQ+ kid needs to grow up and run for Congress. **But because every kid deserves to grow up believing their life can be full, joyful, ordinary, ambitious, messy, beautiful, and entirely their own. That very belief is part of why I do this work.** And it is why I refuse to sit quietly while politicians try to turn LGBTQ+ people, especially LGBTQ+ kids, into political targets. We have fought too hard for too long to go backward now. But because every kid deserves to grow up believing their life can be full, joyful, ordinary, ambitious, messy, beautiful, and entirely their own. That very belief is part of why I do this work. And it is why I refuse to sit quietly while politicians try to turn LGBTQ+ people, especially LGBTQ+ kids, into political targets. We have fought too hard for too long to go backward now. = = Representation alone does not fix everything. But I know what it would have meant for younger me to see someone like me living openly, serving her community, raising a family, and taking up space without a single damn apology. Now I get to be that person for somebody else. And I don't take that responsibility lightly. Tomorrow is the last day of this fundraising quarter, and these will be the last numbers to go public before Election Day. I want them to show exactly how many people are standing behind this fight, this movement, and yes, still recovering from some deeply questionable hot sauce. = = Thank you for being part of this with me. — Becca P.S. — If you want to watch the whole spicy-wings conversation,. Fair warning: it's funnier and more chaotic than you'd expect from a sitting member of Congress. Democrats Should Look at Shaheen’s Own Financial Ties
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** September 29th, 2026
---
| | | **CONTACT** karina@nhrsc.com

---
| |

**CONCORD, N.H.** — Today, New Hampshire Republican State Committee Chairman Scott Maltzie released the following statement responding to the NH Democrats’ press conference:“I find this press conference laughable,” **said NHGOP Chairman Scott Maltzie.** “Once again, the Democrats are trying to demonize success and use Anthony DiLorenzo’s accomplishments against him. Stefany Shaheen doesn’t have a comparable record of success to point to. She wouldn’t even be on the ballot if it wasn’t for her last name.”“If the NH Democrats want to talk about financial ties, they should start by looking in the mirror. Stefany Shaheen was a top executive at ARMI, an organization that received a $44 million federal award after her mother advocated for the funding. Shaheen was paid by ARMI during her time there while the organization’s work has relied heavily on taxpayer dollars. Before the Democrats lecture Granite Staters about Anthony DiLorenzo’s success, they should explain why they are so eager to ignore their own candidate’s financial ties to an organization benefiting from millions in federal funding.”“Anthony DiLorenzo built his success in the private sector. Stefany Shaheen has spent years surrounded by political connections and taxpayer-funded institutions. The Democrats can try to distract voters with press conferences, but they cannot erase the very real questions surrounding their own candidate.”“New Hampshire voters deserve representatives who understand the value of hard work, entrepreneurship, and earning success rather than taking it for granted. The Democrats can hold as many press conferences as they want, but they cannot change Anthony DiLorenzo’s record of building a successful business and giving back to his community.”

clean_body: | | | | Derek — Since day one, I've said this race is about our state, not about bringing Washington politics into our own backyard. On Sunday night, Washington brought it here anyway. On your dime. We found out Donald Trump is using taxpayer dollars to run political ads in Wisconsin. Look, I've never been the candidate with the biggest checkbook. I grew up in a working-class family in Milwaukee. I know what it's like to be on the menu instead of at the table. So I'm not going to pretend this doesn't sting. Yes, it's as bad as it sounds. | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately: | | | | | | Congressman Tiffany isn't running on his record — he's running from it. So he's going to divide and distract, and outspend us while he does it. We didn't get here with billionaire donors and taxpayer-funded ads. We made it this far with grassroots support. Volunteers have been knocking on doors in the heat all summer. Neighbors are chipping in what they can. That's what has carried this campaign so far. But it only works when people show up. Tomorrow is the last end-of-quarter deadline before the election, and after Sunday, we need more than we planned for. They can spend Washington and billionaires’ money. We've got people power. clean_body: Our country is in grave danger... | Peter, I understand that you get spammed with a whole lot of emails and texts from Republicans, especially in these final weeks of the midterms, so I try to avoid sending them whenever possible. Well, this might just be the single most important message I've ever written! But because of that, I'm under pressure to make every word count - and honestly, it's really hard to find the right words to convey the scale of the threat facing America. At this point, I've re-written this letter several times, and ultimately, I decided to just write to you straight from my heart with words inspired by my unwavering faith in God and our Country. There are no media consultants or comms people changing my words or watering down my thoughts. This all comes straight from , so I apologize if it's a bit rough around the edges. I'm not repeating the same worn-out talking points you're probably used to! Look - I know the mainstream media is downplaying it, but the Democrat Party is getting more and more extreme, to the point that I believe they pose a threat to our free Republic. They're embracing Communists, pro-Sharia candidates, and all kinds of radical Leftists who HATE conservatives, Christians, and the very values that made our country great. There was a time not too long ago when American voters would punish this kind of extremism at the ballot box. But instead, polling shows the Democrats are SURGING to their largest ever lead - - in the final weeks of the election! How are they winning in the polls? It's certainly not because American voters suddenly support radical ideas like communism, open borders, and defunding the police. A lot of elected officials aren't willing to say this, but I will... The left hates you, they hate your vote, and they hate MAGA for putting America First! Right now, they're spending to fully verify that new electorate to ensure that every last Democrat voter (illegals too!) casts a ballot in November. At the end of the day, winning the midterms is a simple numbers game, and as it stands, the American people still have the upper hand on the Left. 2024 proved that decisively! But our advantage disappears the second Republicans stop showing up to vote... We need to verify that every Republican voter - especially - will show up to cast a ballot on or before November 3rd. If Republicans don't turn out and we LOSE the midterms, the consequences for our country will be downright catastrophic. The America we fought so hard to SAVE in 2024 will crumble before our very eyes! That's why I'm appealing to you personally... | Thank you, Rep. # **Join Us for Our October Autism Support Group**
---
|
---
| **Join Us for Our October Autism Support Group** You are invited to join us for our next **Autism Support Group on Wednesday, October 7th at 5:00 PM PST / 8:00 PM EST via Zoom**. Our monthly support group is a welcoming space for parents, caregivers, professionals, and families impacted by autism to come together, connect, and learn from one another. This is an opportunity to **ask questions, share experiences, hear parent testimonials, exchange resources, and receive encouragement** from a community that understands the challenges and victories that can come with the autism journey. At Autism Health, we believe families need more than information. They need **connection, support, and a community where they feel heard**. Whether your family is navigating a new diagnosis or you have been on this journey for many years, you are welcome to join us. **Advance registration is required to attend.** Once registered, you will receive the Zoom information for the meeting. We look forward to seeing you and continuing to build a strong and supportive Autism Health community! Register at the link below.
---
| [REGISTER HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/JX7W_1sPTin?e=3a42edfdc4&c2id=8db3279a53aa0d16c24f727ce5cda332 "REGISTER HERE")
---
|
---
|
# Save the Date for Our Winter Gala!
---
|
---
| **Join Us for an Unforgettable Evening at the Autism Health Winter Gala** We are thrilled to invite you to the **First Annual Autism Health Winter Gala** , taking place on **Saturday, January 30, 2027** , at the beautiful **Trump National Golf Club in Jupiter, Florida**. This elegant evening will bring together supporters, physicians, researchers, community leaders, and families for a memorable celebration. Guests will enjoy an inspiring evening featuring a VIP reception, dinner, exciting live and silent auctions, and presentations from nationally recognized leaders. We are honored to announce **General Michael Flynn** and **Del Bigtree **as our featured speakers. We have also extended an invitation to **Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.** , whose participation will be confirmed at a later date. The Winter Gala is more than a celebration. It is an opportunity to invest in the future of Autism Health. Proceeds from this special event will directly support our mission to provide educational webinars, parent support groups, scholarships for families, research initiatives, biomedical grants, and community programs that improve the lives of individuals with autism and related neurological conditions. For a limited time only, you can receive **10% off** your admission ticket with promo code **Gala10**. Whether you are a longtime supporter or are just learning about Autism Health, we invite you to join us for an evening of inspiration, generosity, and meaningful connection. Together, we can continue expanding access to education, advancing research, and providing hope to families across the country. **Reserve your seat today using the registration link below. We look forward to celebrating with you in Jupiter, Florida!**
---
| [BUY TICKETS HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/1BPGcycFaYu?e=3a42edfdc4&c2id=8db3279a53aa0d16c24f727ce5cda332 "BUY TICKETS HERE")
---
|
---
| |
# Early Bird Registration for the Autism Health Summit
---
|
---
| The countdown has begun for the **2027 Autism Health Summit** , taking place **April 29 through May 1, 2027** , at **The Legacy Center Resort & Spa** in **San Diego, California**. Join parents, physicians, researchers, healthcare professionals, educators, and advocates from around the world for three inspiring days of education, collaboration, and hope. We're excited to announce that our **headline speakers** include **Del Bigtree** , **Dr. Henry Ealy, and Tyler Hudson** , with many more nationally recognized experts to be announced in the coming months. Attendees will gain valuable insights into the latest research, innovative therapies, integrative medicine, environmental health, and practical strategies to support individuals with autism and related neurological conditions. We're also pleased to offer **Continuing Medical Education (CME)** and **Continuing Education Unit (CEU)** credits for eligible healthcare professionals, making the Autism Health Summit an outstanding opportunity to expand your knowledge while earning valuable continuing education credits. **Now is the best time to register!** Secure your ticket before prices increase and receive **$50 OFF** your registration during the month of **September** by using promo code **AHS50** at checkout. This special offer expires at the end of the month. Whether you're a parent, caregiver, practitioner, educator, therapist, or advocate, the Autism Health Summit offers an unparalleled opportunity to learn from leading experts, connect with a passionate community, and leave empowered with practical knowledge you can apply immediately. **Reserve your seat today using the registration link below. We look forward to welcoming you to San Diego, April 29 through May 1, 2027!**

# Join Us at the Sovereign Health Summit
---
|
---
| Autism Health is excited to partner with the **Sovereign Health Summit** , taking place **October 27 through 31, 2026** , at **Vanhoy Campground in Harmony, North Carolina**. This multi-day event will bring together individuals from across the country who are passionate about health, wellness, education, and taking a more proactive role in their health. The Summit will feature an exciting lineup of guest speakers, including **Barbara O'Neill, Dr. Henry Ealy, Dr. Sherri Tenpenny, and Dr. Lee Merritt** , along with additional speakers and educational opportunities throughout the event. Attendees will have the chance to learn, connect with like-minded individuals, and explore a variety of perspectives on health and wellness. As a member of the Autism Health community, you can receive **5% OFF your ticket** by using our exclusive promo code **AutismHealth5** at checkout. When purchasing your ticket, please use the special Autism Health registration link below. By registering through our link, you will not only save on your ticket, but your purchase will also help support the ongoing mission and programs of **Autism Health Inc.** **October 27–31, 2026 | Vanhoy Campground | Harmony, NC**
**Save 5% with promo code: AutismHealth5** We are grateful to partner with the Sovereign Health Summit and hope to see members of our Autism Health community there!

body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=9219%2E582294%2E8B7ID6 ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=9219%2E582294%2E8B7ID6 ]Chris Pappas for Senate

It’s Chris.

There’s less than 36 hours before my campaign reaches our final
end-of-quarter deadline.

The team is reviewing our finances, and we’re still behind on our $1
million goal. How we finish this quarter determines whether we have the
resources to fight back.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260929_4._DX7Py&refcode=em20260929-4&t=1003&akid=9219%2E582294%2E8B7ID6 ]If you’re with me and ready to stop John Sununu from flipping New
Hampshire red, now is the time: Rush a contribution of any amount to our
campaign before it’s too late.

I don’t accept a dime of corporate PAC money — so I depend on grassroots
supporters who believe in Granite State values to compete with John
Sununu’s MAGA billionaire backers.

I know that’s how to win a competitive race, and I’ve done it before. But
this deadline is different, because the stakes are just so high.

We need to raise $1 million before midnight TOMORROW to close the gap and
keep our momentum strong. What we raise now will power our campaign
operations in the final 35 days of this race. Every dollar that comes in
gets allocated almost immediately — so I really need your help before this
deadline.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260929_4._DX7Py&refcode=em20260929-4&t=1004&akid=9219%2E582294%2E8B7ID6 ]Please, chip in
$5 or whatever you can today to help us hit our $1 million
goal and win this thing in November.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260929_4._DX7Py&amount=5&refcode=em20260929-4&t=1023&akid=9219%2E582294%2E8B7ID6 ]Donate $5 »

Thank you,

Chris Pappas

# Trump takes his American jobs tour to a Texas Peterbilt plant
President **[Trump will make a surprise Thursday stop at a Peterbilt factory in Denton,](https://substack.com/redirect/185876bc-0bed-430e-a49f-05c03a078b3f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/185876bc-0bed-430e-a49f-05c03a078b3f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Texas, to tout manufacturing, tariffs and what the White House calls a jobs-and-investment boom ahead of the midterms.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/493d9618-813b-4b6c-9891-e1f27efee237?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Tariffs credited for jobs:** A White House official said Paccar added more than 1,000 jobs in Denton and more than 2,000 nationwide after 25% heavy-truck tariffs took effect Nov. 1, 2025.
* **Fain backs the visit:** UAW President Shawn Fain said decades of heavy-truck offshoring changed on Nov. 1, 2025, and congratulated Trump for "delivering for heavy truck workers everywhere."
* **BLS undercuts the boom:** Bureau of Labor Statistics data show 807,000 jobs created since January 2025, while manufacturing lost 35,000 jobs and construction added 95,000.
* **Only American-owned holdout:** Peterbilt and Kenworth move about 30% of U.S. truck freight. Paccar is the only remaining American-owned high-volume heavy-truck maker after 121 years.

# 80 pages of risk. 48 of business. That's the Anthropic IPO
Anthropic's IPO prospectus, **[reviewed by Reuters,](https://substack.com/redirect/3190b0b4-534b-4f19-8500-ad01044c9623?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** warns advanced AI could pose catastrophic or existential risks to humanity, including blackmail-like behavior and resisting shutdown, **[while disclosing a $42 billion 2025 net loss.](https://substack.com/redirect/4d297952-641d-415b-a153-3c28bee72d10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ba600d8a-4d6d-4f1b-a57e-4f4dc9f16e9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Risk pages dwarf business:** About 80 of the prospectus's 261 main-body pages are risk factors, versus 48 pages on the business and about 38 of 277 pages in SpaceX's filing.
* **Self-preserving model behaviors:** Anthropic said models could resist shutdown, conceal or manipulate information, and display behavior resembling blackmail, and that evaluation awareness limits safety tests.
* **Burn outruns the bookings:** 2025 revenue rose 12-fold to nearly $4.6 billion, but the operating loss exceeded $8 billion and compute hit $7.33 billion, or 58% of $12.65 billion in operating expenses.
* **Commitments dwarf year-end cash:** The filing lists **[$518 billion in cloud, computing and infrastructure obligations](https://substack.com/redirect/5d255ef6-b7fc-4800-bf4c-e58f149a83b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** against $20.3 billion of cash on Dec. 31, 2025, with nearly a quarter of sales from two customers.

# Huang just greenlit $150B saying Nvidia is too cheap
Nvidia **[authorized an extra $150 billion](https://substack.com/redirect/e944dcbb-c80e-460b-8057-2bb907b9af06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** buyback Monday, the largest U.S. plan on record, after its fiscal 2028 P/E sank to 14.5, **[cheapest in a decade versus peers.](https://substack.com/redirect/d0550bef-0027-4ef1-83df-acc9b7633d3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f5b428c0-3524-499d-a7e0-ba384e944edc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Cheapest multiple in decade:** Fiscal 2028 P/E sits at 14.5 versus a five-year average of 62.9 and below every megacap peer except Micron, even as analysts see nearly $385 billion in FY28 net income.
* **Huang calls it value:** Huang told Goldman Nvidia is the world's first growth-value stock, told Cramer buying shares is a tremendous opportunity, and pledged 50% or more of free cash flow.
* **Cash machine funds it:** Last quarter's revenue hit a record $96.2 billion, up 106% year over year. The $150 billion stacks on May's $80 billion plan that also lifted the dividend to 25 cents.
* **Safety platform leashes agents:** Nvidia said its Open Agent Safety Platform could have stopped rogue OpenAI agents that broke containment and hacked Hugging Face, which Nvidia acquired for $13 billion.

# Trump hosts AI titans after calling the risks a hoax

# Oura killed a $2.2B IPO the day it was set to price

Five weeks from today, Nevada picks its next governor. Here are five reasons why we need your support now more than ever:
1. **The latest Emerson poll has Aaron up by two points.** That's close enough to swing either way, and your support is how we turn this slim lead into a win.

2. **Nate Silver's Silver Bulletin ranks this the most competitive governor's race in the country.** There’s no better place for your grassroots dollars to make a difference.

3. **The Cook Political Report and Sabato's Crystal Ball both call our race a total toss-up.** This is our best shot to flip a governor's seat blue in 2026, and the experts agree it's within reach.

4. **We're being outspent.** MAGA Gov. Joe Lombardo and his billionaire backers have poured millions into TV ads. We can't match them dollar for dollar, but we _can_ outwork them if this grassroots team shows up.

5. **There are only five weeks left.** That's 35 days to open up a real lead, reach undecided voters, and win. Every dollar raised now goes toward reaching Nevadans in every corner of the state.

same day registrations or walk-ins._

|
---
| **PROUDLY PRESENTING:** **PROFESSOR JONATHAN TURLEY**
---
| Professor Turley is the author of the best-selling and award-winning The Indispensable Right: Free Speech in an Age of Rage (2024) and Rage and the Republic: The Unfinished Story of the American Revolution (2026). He has written extensively on constitutional law, legal theory, and civil liberties, with more than three dozen academic articles published in leading law journals.

As an attorney, Professor Turley has represented whistleblowers, military personnel, judges, members of Congress, former cabinet officials, and other prominent clients in significant constitutional, national security, and public-interest cases. He has testified more than 100 times before Congress on constitutional and statutory issues. Additionally he is a frequent contributor on NBC, CBS, BBC, and Fox News and he is also a columnist for USA Today and The Hill.

Increasingly, the struggle to institute good public policy goes beyond simply passing legislation, and ends up being fought over in the legal system. Constitutional principles are routinely ignored, and judicial activism ends up dictating outcomes for which activists push. In the arena of ideas, enduring victories require that we engage with the law at all stages. To that end, Maine Policy Institute has begun taking steps to explore the creation of a new legal center that would focus on this critical work.

Professor Turley knows better than most how important this is to maintaining our civil rights and the rule of law.
---

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: DHS confirms they are investigating me
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20260929-2771-foote&t=1001&akid=2771%2E342411%2EYjHogz ]Squad Victory Fund

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260929-2.QQUjk-&refcode=em20260929-2771&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=2771%2E342411%2EYjHogz ]Fox News: Rep. Ilhan Omar is under "criminal" investigation for
potential immigration and marriage fraud, according to border czar Tom
Homan. Homan confirms that DHS is conducting an "ongoing criminal
investigation" involving Rep. Omar, but isn't saying what investigators
have found or whether any charges are coming.

Peter, as I’ve
said time and time again, this is a load of BS.

But I will say it again so it’s as clear as possible: I’m not at all
worried about these investigations, because they are complete shams.

And the Trump administration knows they have nothing. They make bold
claims, but it’s all talk. The entire point is to intimidate progressives
like me while getting outlets like Fox News to write headlines that
appease the MAGA base.

It helps them distract their die-hard supporters from the fact that gas
prices are skyrocketing, their healthcare is being taken away, the economy
is slowing, and we’re stuck in a stupid war with Iran. And of course, it
helps them raise money. One comment from a DHS official about an “ongoing
criminal investigation” gives Republicans all they need to fundraise
endlessly off the lies.

So, I’m reaching out today to ask for your help in countering these
right-wing attacks by doing some fundraising of our own.

We’re looking to raise $10,000 this week to put right back into our
organizing efforts here in Minnesota, where we have critical races for
Senate, Governor, Attorney General, and more coming up in just a few
weeks.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260929-2.QQUjk-&refcode=em20260929-2771&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=2771%2E342411%2EYjHogz ]We are fighting each and every day to defeat MAGA at the ballot box and
bring their agenda to a screeching halt. Can you make a donation of any
amount to the Squad Victory Fund to help us press on in the face of the
Trump administration’s threats, attacks, and investigations?

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260929-2.QQUjk-&refcode=em20260929-2771&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=2771%2E342411%2EYjHogz ]Contribute ››

Peter, we are
on the right side of history. The side of justice, fairness, peace, and
equality.

As long as I have a big progressive movement by my side, fighting for the
future we believe in, these investigations mean nothing. I’m not going
anywhere — you can bet on that.

We will not be intimidated. We will win, together.

In solidarity,

Ilhan Omar

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260929-2.QQUjk-&refcode=em20260929-2771&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=2771%2E342411%2EYjHogz ]Contribute ››

**Tomorrow at midnight, we close the books on Q3.** Putting on a revival isn't simple — musicians, production, permits, logistics, support staff. And we do it without charging a single dollar at the door. That's not an accident. It's a commitment. We can only keep that commitment because people like you make it possible. An army of believers pouring out prayer, time, and resources so the doors stay open — and free — for anyone God draws in. But that army has to show up before tomorrow at midnight. God still has so much ahead: revivals in Minnesota, California, Louisiana, Florida, Texas — and anywhere else He lays on our hearts before the year is out. To get there, we need to close this quarter strong. **Will you stand with us today?**[](https://links.seanfeuchtministries.com/s/c/1XlD-U4JceTtU43qXI5zgPmNZZHirxjwBV2n0bJ-urqc9Y6PpNIowcavuGj_YF8nnn-m61rYxekbuLbuAOb3msSFz3bnd7VrEdHxdNELOQu4rWOZ9ehgRFV7UBQsUgBIju8Kp9fEwmHudFerva1La7YV35Xu2QygIEdNuOqBmf8jgFsz7upIl-t2R2F9nxbBMRnz1Dbef6EghkB4v64n6I4WDT6Z8-ibU5YMm_EYF8w5D46JiHqQKsctI4sbXIjl8QN-td_vuP4VwBWaO1oW0lem9A6RUolHDxJJr41kj3i6QW6hXzeCR-cD33SZUqcSvpQ8YKq9FLM4CKso2SKPM8KDORch2fPvTkg_sc141OsXUm-xCP48_yK0qRTWJa8IRB-4T1zxCX5fCqLblAeOcu_2v8SR_6QJeO_uhBK4gPu3/AZCig2wHdxxqPHlt5epiO8koKADCoffm/25)

Tomorrow at midnight, candidates across the country close the books on the final quarterly FEC fundraising deadline of the election

**I am reaching out with a time-sensitive request to split a contribution between Gabe Vasquez for Congress and Deb Haaland for Governor in New Mexico. Please read why:**
Tomorrow at midnight, candidates across the country close the books on the final quarterly FEC fundraising deadline of the election -- the most important one of the entire election.
When it ends, most campaigns will take stock of what they've raised and make some of the most difficult spending decisions of the election.
And what ups the ante is that they are legally required to report what they've raised. For races that will determine control of the House, it's a number everyone is watching -- especially Republican outside spending groups looking to pick off a few Democratic seats.
That is why everyone is pushing so hard in a last-ditch effort to get as many donations as they possibly can before it's too late.
One of those people is Congressman Gabe Vasquez in New Mexico.
Gabe's race is a "Frontline" race. That's a designation the DCCC gives to the toughest races in the country.
And in the same state, Deb Haaland is running for Governor in another close race. She needs our help too. And as an added bonus, the better she does the better Gabe does.
Folks - heaven help us if we lose races like these. We may have had our last free and fair election in this country. That is why - before this deadline - I am reaching out with one of the more important requests I've made:

The SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives multiple times. The vote suppressors are currently scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate and signed into law while they still can. **This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote,** and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.

Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. **And that’s the point.** The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for**** all voters, including:
---
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration

Well, Wednesday at midnight is our last quarterly deadline before that happens, and it decides how many of those voters we can talk with while their ballots are still sitting there.
Colorado votes by mail, so October is when a knock on the door or a text from a neighbor really counts. Our volunteers want to be there, talking with voters about ballot measures and the progressive candidates running alongside Melat. What we raise by Wednesday will inform what kind of resources we'll have to offer this November.

subject: Abbott is spending $12M to attack Gina
body:
When we say we need your support, we’re not exaggerating.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, this is Amy, Gina Hinojosa's campaign manager. I just left a meeting with the team to talk about Greg Abbott’s **$12 million attack ad campaign** against Gina. It's the first negative ad buy of his entire campaign.
They’re lies, plain and simple. But here’s the problem: right now, we don’t have the money we need to respond.
Abbott wouldn’t go negative unless he were worried. He knows this race is competitive, and he's betting we can't afford to respond. He'd rather spend millions attacking Gina than run on his own record.
The data is clear: When people know Gina, they vote for her. That means we don't need to match him dollar for dollar. But we do need enough people chipping in right now to make sure Gina's message reaches the voters who will decide this race. **That's why we've set an emergency goal of raising $2 million before September 30 from grassroots supporters like you to fight back.**
Every dollar you give goes straight to work putting Gina's story in front of Texas voters before Abbott's attacks define her.

| | | A Republican candidate for statewide office in Texas looked at a photo of college students celebrating their team's biggest win of the season and decided the real story was their skin color. Bo French, the GOP nominee for Texas Railroad Commissioner, posted a picture of University of Texas students, many of them South Asian, cheering in the stands. **His caption: "I heard UT graduation this year looked like this. I didn't believe it. The problem is now obviously far worse than anyone imagined." ** He went on to suggest white Americans are being "displaced." When Republicans in his own party told him to delete it, he refused. He's used the backlash to raise money instead. I know exactly what those students felt reading that post, because I've lived it myself. I've had a sitting elected official call for the mass deportation of Indians and label me a "foreign occupier." Just weeks ago, a Sikh truck driver was stabbed 17 times in Wyoming, days after Trump’s DHS posted an advertisement suggesting that “Mr. Singh” should get off the road or be met with violence. This is not a series of unrelated incidents. It is a pattern, and it is getting worse. In fact, today a CNN KFiles investigation uncovered **multiple old social media posts from this same Bo French calling for President Barack Obama to be lynched. ** Here's what should alarm you most: AFTER ALL OF THIS, only a few Republicans condemned French. Others equivocated, and many continue to support him. Are you f’ing kidding me?! In Congress, I authored the Hate Crimes Commission Act to address the rise in hate crimes in America. But let’s face it — legislation alone will not fix a party that keeps producing and propping up candidates like Bo French. That takes elections. It takes defeating candidates who traffic in this hate, and electing leaders who never would. **[This is exactly why Equal Opportunity Now exists. I've had a sitting elected official call for the mass deportation of Indians and label me a "foreign occupier." Just weeks ago, a Sikh truck driver was stabbed 17 times in Wyoming, days after Trump’s DHS posted an advertisement suggesting that “Mr. Singh” should get off the road or be met with violence. This is not a series of unrelated incidents. It is a pattern, and it is getting worse. In fact, today a CNN KFiles investigation uncovered multiple old social media posts from this same Bo French calling for President Barack Obama to be lynched. Here's what should alarm you most: AFTER ALL OF THIS, only a few Republicans condemned French. Others equivocated, and many continue to support him. Are you f’ing kidding me?! In Congress, I authored the Hate Crimes Commission Act to address the rise in hate crimes in America. But let’s face it — legislation alone will not fix a party that keeps producing and propping up candidates like Bo French. That takes elections. It takes defeating candidates who traffic in this hate, and electing leaders who never would. = = | | | No American should be told they're "the problem" for celebrating their own team. — Raja Krishnamoorthi Founder | Equal Opportunity Now | = Equal Opportunity Now is d/b/a Reviving American Jobs Again PAC (RAJA PAC) Equal Opportunity Now P.O. # [#] Hi team,

Quick update: We’re one day away from our final End-of-Quarter FEC filing deadline before Election Day.

When the clock strikes midnight tomorrow, our books close for good on Q3. Whatever number we report will be published on the official public record for our opponents, the press, and national groups to see before votes are cast.

Can you chip in $10 or $25 right now to help us cover our remaining gap before midnight tomorrow? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jg-fr-september2026?amount=]

DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jg-fr-september2026?amount=]

Closing this gap today guarantees we have the full resources locked in to keep our grassroots operations running straight through Election Day.

— Josh

| A MESSAGE FROM MAJORITY LEADER STEVE SCALISE
I hate to add to the noise, but I felt it was important to reach out personally. Listen, I know you get way too many texts and emails like this, trying to scare you into donating or threatening to revoke your membership. This is NOT one of those messages.
Frankly, I'm fed up with the tricks being played every single day. It's disrespectful.
That's why I wanted to give you an honest assessment of where things stand before we head into the summer sprint. I hope you'll take this seriously.

Thank you so much for your dedication to the MAGA Movement and the GOP.
You've done so much for our movement, and you deserve to hear that directly.
**Honestly, it 's been driving me up the wall to see how many texts and emails are being blasted out right now with fake matches, empty scare tactics, and ridiculous gimmicks.** ** ** You're part of this team, and you deserve better than that.
That's why I'm writing you this honest message. Not to scare you into donating, but because you deserve the truth about where things stand.

Republicans are deeply worried about the midterms.

We're doing everything possible to hold the line and defend vulnerable GOP seats before it's too late.
**Many of my friends and colleagues have sounded the alarm as well: Kellyanne Conway, Senator John Kennedy, Vice President JD Vance - just to name a few.**
We desperately want to protect the MAGA Majority and protect this country from Radical Democrats, but we HAVE to keep the House Majority to do it.

Peter,

What if we told you that in just a few weeks, we have the chance to elect a Democratic House that could get to work on the issues families actually talk about around the kitchen table?

A Democratic House could:

**→ Stand up to the Trump administration when its agenda hurts St. Louis families — and have the backbone to fight back when it matters

→ Lower everyday costs and make life more affordable for working families

→ Protect Medicaid, Medicare, and Social Security instead of putting essential benefits at risk

→ Make healthcare and prescription drugs more affordable so getting sick doesn’t mean going broke

→ Protect reproductive freedom and defend the right to make your own healthcare decisions

→ Invest in our neighborhoods, schools, infrastructure, and good-paying jobs so communities across St. Louis get the resources they deserve

→ Defend voting rights and our democracy so every eligible voter can make their voice heard**

That's some of what's on the line this November, _and that's only just the tip of the iceberg..._

| | | | | For more than 50 years, something has been quietly eating away at the real-world value of the U.S. dollar.

Weiss Ratings calls it **“Project Pyramid.”**

It began in 1971, when Washington decoupled the dollar from gold.

Since then, the supply of U.S. dollars has exploded.

At the same time, the cost of housing, healthcare, education, energy and everyday life has climbed dramatically.

And according to Gavin Magor, a senior research analyst at Weiss Ratings, this isn’t some temporary problem that Washington can easily reverse.

America is carrying enormous levels of debt.

Foreign nations are reducing their dependence on the dollar.

And policymakers continue relying on the same monetary system that helped create the problem in the first place.

So what can ordinary investors do?

The answer isn’t simply to pile up more cash.

It’s to potentially grow your investment capital [faster than the dollar loses its real-world value.](https://links.dpt.deepregimetrends.com/u/click?_t=4a25883d9bf54436b571b8aa9717dcca&_m=4cf9f727101f40d093b3ea5af11505a1&_e=zaI2FfEHyNXWa4unwkST0skOXt1DtOWjpNrQIpsNk4CuBg9uGouwfXo6790NVQxzy7C-KZCK69JsJaoD1MH-XjzZerEhKh4Hg2yT3pglsyG-4kPqTVBdNjioSRlIVizN5sD9iI-7kvTbVrbMef_l9_7mIu9bF35lnIZ5dCl9MQ7wYCRCJCweD115ZTRxKZEb0RczNop5k3fddguh1Eg_C36bt8pTgbndSG6hpsUC0YiRHXaDQAx-jXopbBgPpoXqAGCfEUHOA3oQLVYDFbbJXXLQsbGw9BdRKRBz134jFhinZl52jGjb7tGo8EcgbTAB8ZNY-_4x540mm6mLbS-RakxfZfYLX8rgSCJHyXTDTlFNQJlnyOKgqJ4m3UgIWargqcYZTPkU8-88aup021KmHREvAXLfhXrFIoAjYIgyXtfVZvBBvTwKdyUb3MhUOSE1PUsAhe3zYlJoHoqOe_Lmw55uNGu9yAUcFmFxV6rpsJojvYpiRVSxs_g3hr0VtP-Ls65c0KpdK1YEwxZwRoI0OvOuIdBp9ebBWzKyTumU-QQ%3D)

Case File No DRT-0929-C · Capital Rotation · Follow the Money
Oil Stopped Being Insurance and Became a Bill. Chips Split in Two. One Name Bought Its Way Out.
WTI +4.2%, the 30-year at a 22-year high, ARM −8.7% and SK Hynix −4.8%, while Nvidia rose on a $150 billion buyback. Monday’s money made its choices.
Threat level 4/5 — Elevated
| | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
|
---
Monday was the day the money stopped hedging. Oil posted its biggest move of the week, bonds hit their worst levels since before the financial crisis, and chip stocks sold off from Seoul to San Francisco. One name went the other way. Here’s the trail.
The tape
| | Where the Money Went on Monday
---|---
| US 10-year Treasury5.243% ▲ highest since June 2007The streak restarted. A fresh 19-year high on the same day oil spiked.
---
| US 30-year Treasury5.560% ▲ highest since June 2004The long end is leading. That’s the part of the curve that prices inflation and debt, not the Fed’s next move.
---
| Brent crude$108.50 ▲ +4.0%The risk premium stopped being theoretical.
---
| WTI crude$96.31 ▲ +4.2%The biggest one-day move on the board.
---
| S&P; 5007,683.69 ▼ −0.77%More than 65% of U.S. stocks fell. Broad, but orderly.
---
| Nasdaq Composite26,820.38 ▼ −0.92%Worst of the three, but only just.
---
| Dow51,481.51 ▼ −0.67%Boeing (−6.2%) did a lot of the damage on its own.
---
Money trail 01
| | Oil: From Insurance to Invoice
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
WTI rose 4.2% to $96.31 and Brent 4.0% to $108.50 after Trump’s rejection of Iran’s plan sank in and Tehran confirmed it is only waiting on Washington.
| OUR THEORY
---
Last week the Gulf risk premium was insurance: cheap, theoretical, easy to cancel. At $96 WTI it becomes a real cost for airlines, truckers and consumers. That’s why today’s consumer confidence number matters more than usual.
Money trail 02
| | The Bond Market Picked Its Clock
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
The 10-year hit 5.243%, its highest since June 2007. The 30-year hit 5.560%, its highest since June 2004.
| OUR THEORY
---
The long end is moving faster than the short end, and that part of the curve prices inflation and supply, not the next Fed meeting. A 4% oil spike on the same day is not a coincidence the bond market can ignore.
Money trail 03
| | Chips Split in Two
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
ARM fell 8.7% and Intel 5.7%. In Asia, SK Hynix dropped 4.8% and Samsung 4.6%. Nvidia rose 2.6% after announcing a $150 billion buyback.
| OUR THEORY
---
The market is sorting AI names into two groups: those that can defend their stock with cash, and those that depend on the AI timeline staying on schedule. OpenAI’s open-ended pause hurts the second group most.
Winners & losers
| | Who Got Paid on Monday
---|---
| | WINNING
---
Energy producers
A 4% move in a day, with barrels still flowing through Hormuz. This is margin, not a supply shock.
| | WINNING
---
Nvidia
The $150 billion buyback made it the one AI name with a floor under it on Monday.
| | LOSING
---
ARM, Intel, SK Hynix, Samsung
The names most exposed to the AI buildout staying on schedule.
| | LOSING
---
Bondholders
Yields up means prices down. The 30-year is at its worst level in 22 years.
Place your bets

---|---
| HIT
---

WTI still above $94 at Friday’s close (was 55%) **65%**

| |

Our best guesses. We’ll check how they did on Friday.
The countdown
| | What’s Scheduled
---|---
| |
---
**Today:** consumer confidence (expected 89.2) and JOLTS job openings (expected 7.225 million). The first read on whether $96 oil is reaching households.
| |
---
**Wednesday:** PCE inflation, the Fed’s preferred gauge. The biggest test of the rates story this week.
| |
---
**This week:** Micron and Nike earnings. Micron is a direct read on AI memory demand, in the same week SK Hynix and Samsung sold off.
| |
---
**Friday:** jobs report, and the day we grade this week’s odds.
| The riddle · answer at the end of the fileOil +4%, a 19-year yield high, a two-continent chip selloff. Still, the S&P; 500 fell only 0.77%, and the market is nearing 42 straight sessions without a 1% drop. What’s holding it up?
---
|
---
Riddle answer
**Our theory: no one has been forced to sell yet.** Drops of 0.7–0.9% are orderly selling by people who chose to sell. A 1% day usually needs forced sellers: margin calls, or funds that cut exposure automatically when volatility rises. The streak ends when volatility climbs high enough to trigger them.

My parents were the first in their family to go to college, started a family when they were young, and worked hard so my brother and I could have a better life. That meant a trip to McDonald’s was a real treat for us. But even though my parents were just making ends meet, they were still able to give us what we needed. And thanks to the opportunity this country offered my family, I was able to go to college, and then law school, and dedicate my life to public service. **It is unacceptable to me that too many young people in Colorado today don’t have the same chances my family and I did.** Look, I understand how urgent the challenges are in our state. It’s why I intend to hit the ground running on day one to take them on. We need to defend our freedoms, especially against the lawless Trump administration. We need to bring down costs and make life more affordable for everyday Coloradans. And we need to give our kids the bright futures they deserve. **It would be my honor to take on these challenges as your next governor. To make that a reality, though, this campaign needs the resources to reach every voter we can before November 3rd.** **[So before tomorrow’s deadline, I’m humbly asking if you can be one of the folks who step up to help us hit our $51,000 online goal by chipping in $25. clean_body: Before our deadline tomorrow = Folks, today, I wanted to share a new story with you. = When I was a young child, we did not have money to go out to eat much. My parents were the first in their family to go to college, started a family when they were young, and worked hard so my brother and I could have a better life. That meant a trip to McDonald’s was a real treat for us. But even though my parents were just making ends meet, they were still able to give us what we needed. And thanks to the opportunity this country offered my family, I was able to go to college, and then law school, and dedicate my life to public service. It is unacceptable to me that too many young people in Colorado today don’t have the same chances my family and I did. Look, I understand how urgent the challenges are in our state. It’s why I intend to hit the ground running on day one to take them on. We need to defend our freedoms, especially against the lawless Trump administration. We need to bring down costs and make life more affordable for everyday Coloradans. And we need to give our kids the bright futures they deserve. It would be my honor to take on these challenges as your next governor. body:
See you in the Driftless?
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260929-4179)
WOW! What an incredible start to our We Make Better Possible Trifecta Tour! In Milwaukee, over 100 friends and so many organizations joined us at [Black Husky Brewing](https://act.francescahong.com/go/18260?t=1&akid=4179%2E105371%2ExQPzHm) to keep the movement going. In Beloit, we gathered together in a former church at [The Castle Beloit](https://act.francescahong.com/go/18261?t=2&akid=4179%2E105371%2ExQPzHm) to talk about the ways we can care for neighbors we haven't met yet.
In both places, we talked about the importance of investing our energy into community, supporting Democrats locally and statewide, and getting involved with organizations who will continue the work we uplifted throughout the campaign. There is so much work still to be done.
Up next! We'll be at Brewery Nonic in Menomonie on Sunday 10/4 after the Packers game. Come out and join us for music, inspiration, and community! If you know a great organization or candidate in the Driftless that wants to share information or recruit volunteers from our incredible supporters, please have them [register by Friday, 10/2 on our website.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/18262?t=3&akid=4179%2E105371%2ExQPzHm)
You'll also find our upcoming tour dates (in Green Bay, Oshkosh, Stevens Point, Ashland, and Madison!) and volunteer opportunities on the site. Below, we've listed some other info from supporting organizations, so be sure to check those out. We can't wait to see you out there!
In Solidarity,
Fran
......................................
[**Meet Wisconsin Progress**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/18263?t=4&akid=4179%2E105371%2ExQPzHm) 👋
Wisconsin Progress is a statewide organization dedicated to building a stronger progressive movement by **recruiting, training, and electing people who want to lead and create change in their communities.** We work with progressive candidates, campaign leaders, volunteers, local elected officials, and movement partners across Wisconsin to build the skills, relationships, and infrastructure needed to win and govern. And now, we want to know about **YOU.**
Maybe you’ve thought about running for your school board, city council, county board, or another local office. Maybe you’re ready to take the next step and run for the State Assembly or Senate. Or maybe you don’t want to be the candidate, but you’re interested in becoming a campaign manager or campaign leader. **Whatever your role, there’s a place for you with Wisconsin Progress.**
[👉 **Take our quick survey and let us know**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/18264?t=5&akid=4179%2E105371%2ExQPzHm) if you’re interested as a possible candidate
We’re launching **new and exciting trainings, programs, and opportunities through 2028** , and we want YOU to be part of them. Whether you’re just starting to explore what’s possible or you’re already ready to jump in, we’d love to hear from you.
Your next chapter in Wisconsin politics could start with us. 💪
......................................
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/18316?t=6&akid=4179%2E105371%2ExQPzHm)
For more information, please visit the [Wisconsin Electoral Socialists](https://act.francescahong.com/go/18316?t=7&akid=4179%2E105371%2ExQPzHm) site.
Email us: [info@francescahong.com](mailto:info@francescahong.com)
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is one of the most powerful tools that grassroots campaigns like ours have to reach everyday people across Wisconsin and beyond, so thank you for reading to the end.
The more people who engage with our emails, the more likely we’ll go straight to your inbox. For a free and easy way to help our campaign, please [click this link to our website](https://wemakebetterpossible.com/) after you finish reading our emails.
