| **NEWS: U.S. Supreme Court (again) blocks the Missouri gerrymander from being used in the midterm election.**
---
Peter,
Are the anti-democracy zealots finally through?
Last Friday’s Supreme Court ruling is a victory for Missouri voters who refused to let their elected state leaders and some judges undermine their right to vote at every turn.
While Missouri Republicans took directions from the White House instead of their own constituents, the people of Missouri stood up for themselves and gave a resounding ‘NO’ to the power-hungry politicians trying to slice up their communities for partisan gain.
Citizens organized, protested, and took this fight all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court — not once, not twice, but three times — and they won, blocking the installation of an egregious mid-decade gerrymander for the 2026 midterms.
**Because of their tenacity, Missourians will continue to vote in this election on a fairer congressional map that keeps Kansas City together. And thanks to their work, voters in the Show-Me State will get a chance at the ballot box to reject the new gerrymander for good.**
The story of the fight for democracy in Missouri is an example for the nation as we continue the struggle to protect the right to vote.
There is no cavalry coming to save us. We, the people, are the cavalry, and we, the people, are more powerful than any political scheme or special interest or ideologically driven judge when we band together and take action.
[**This movement needs you, especially at moments like this when the stakes are highest in the days before a decisive election. Tomorrow is our final public fundraising deadline before the midterms, so I wanted to explain why this one matters so much.
Four Senate seats are all that stand between us and a blue Senate that can stop Trump's agenda in its tracks. Democratic campaigns and organizers have been feeling momentum on the ground for months - and now, forecasters like Nate Silver are saying Democratic odds of flipping those four seats are getting better and better.
**The Republicans are scared. Even Trump 's own super PAC is funneling $49 million into these midterms, pumping resources into races they didn't used to worry about. **That tells me they see what election forecasters are seeing: This map is shifting, and it's shifting toward us.
We need to hit tomorrow's midnight goal because these numbers will be public. This means that everyone - the media, Republicans, billionaire GOP donors - will have real-time information to size up Democratic chances of taking back the Senate.
They're testing us, so we need every dollar we can get to make sure Democrats have what it takes to fight back and win in November.
**[We cannot squander this momentum. So before tomorrow, I hope you'll consider chipping in whatever you're able to help us hit our $50,000 deadline and send a loud, clear message: Democrats are going to flip the Senate blue.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/520f6e27-bdda-4e7c-8104-051eaf760ba1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Jacky

[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
not vague statements.

This is your Mountain Minute for Tuesday, September 29, 2026.

– Team RMV

TODAY'S TOP STORIES

FIVE LAWMAKERS WHO WANT TABOR GONE PUT PROP NN ON YOUR BALLOT
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY SHAINA COLE, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

Five Colorado lawmakers on the November ballot have campaign websites
calling for the Taxpayer’s Bill of Rights to be ended, repealed,
dismantled or abolished.

All five signed on to a 2025 resolution that would have directed the
legislature to sue over whether TABOR is constitutional. And all five
voted to put Proposition NN in front of voters this fall.

Prop NN does not repeal TABOR.

It raises the amount of revenue the state may keep above the TABOR cap
by an amount equal to state public K-12 education funding. The
Legislative Council Staff analysis mailed to every registered voter
household, the Blue Book, says the measure eliminates TABOR refunds
for budget years 2026-27 and 2027-28.

READ MORE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BENES: PROPOSITIONS 133, 134 AND 135 LEAVE COLORADO VOTERS THE LAST
WORD ON PROTECTING KIDS
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY LLOYD BENES, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

_Three citizen-initiated ballot measures, each backed by over 124,000
signatures, would toughen child sex trafficking penalties, protect
girls' sports, and ban sex-change surgery on minors._

*
LIFE SENTENCES FOR CHILD SEX TRAFFICKING: Proposition 133 would
replace current penalties, which allow parole in as little as eight
years, with life without parole, citing Common Sense Institute data
ranking Colorado 13th nationally for trafficking and finding minors
average of 64% of the state's trafficking victims since 2008.

*
A PARTY-LINE FIGHT OVER GIRLS' SPORTS: Proposition 134 would bar
biological males from girls' school sports; the author notes all eight
Democrats on a House committee voted against a similar bill in March
2026 while all three Republicans voted yes, and says he was cut off
from testifying about the related ballot measure.

*
BANNING IRREVERSIBLE SURGERY ON MINORS: Proposition 135 would prohibit
sex-change surgeries for minors, with the author citing federal data
showing 87% of gender-related surgeries on 12-to-18-year-olds from
2016-2020 involved breast or chest procedures.

[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | SEPTEMBER 28

_Okay, confession time. Until preparing this devotion, I wasn’t very
familiar with The Little Red Hen; however, my wife (Sherrie) was.
Somehow, somewhere between childhood, twenty-one years in the
military, ministry, raising a family, and nearly forty years of trying
to become more fully human through Christ (of course!), this little
chicken slipped through the cracks._

GABE EVANS ON HIS RECORD, HIS OPPONENT AND A RACE INSIDE THE MARGIN
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | SEPTEMBER 25

_Gabe Evans still tells the story of his first annual review as a cop.
His sergeant sat him down and said he’d had a great year. Forty-one
arrests, putting him in the top half of the shift. More than 1,800
calls for service._
__

DSA WANTS TO ABOLISH POLICE AND PRISONS. ITS PLAN FOR VIOLENT
OFFENDERS GOES UNSTATED
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY SHAINA COLE | NATIONAL | SEPTEMBER 24

_A television anchor in Los Angeles asked a national leader of the
Democratic Socialists of America a direct question this summer, and
got no direct answer. Frances Gill, a member of DSA’s National
Political Committee, sat for an interview with NBC 4 Los Angeles
anchor Conan Nolan._

**If we lose enough seats like this one, Hakeem Jeffries picks up the gavel and everything we have fought for, including everything President Trump has delivered, stops cold.**

Just Hakeem Jeffries and AOC calling the shots.

September’s been a huge month for our campaign, thanks to you.

Hi there, Peter –
Since we have just over 24 hours left until our last FEC end-of-quarter deadline before Nov. 3, I’m about to ask you to chip in $5 to my Senate campaign in North Carolina.
If you’re short on time, though, and want to have an immediate impact in our fight to flip this seat, [**_you can chip in here now._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1385&amount=5&t=8&akid=3964%2E124072%2EQn87u7)
**You deserve an explanation for today’s request:**
September has been a huge month for our campaign. A surge in grassroots fundraising has enabled us to reach more North Carolinians than ever and, although the GOP doesn’t like it, momentum is clearly on our side.
That’s because of you. I’m grateful for the hundreds of thousands of folks who’ve joined our movement to end the GOP’s one-party rule and return power to working families.
**However, it’s been challenging.** Both President Trump and JD Vance came to North Carolina to rally alongside my opponent, Michael Whatley, and total GOP spending in this race surpassed _$100 million – because the only way he wins is if they literally buy his way to victory.
Republicans know as well as we do that the path for Democrats to retake the Senate runs through North Carolina – and they’re throwing everything at the wall to stop me. After two polls came out the other week showing Whatley closing in on our razor-thin lead, the only way I’ll fight back against the flood of attacks and dark money over these last five weeks is with grassroots support from folks like you.
[**_That’s why I need your help to reach the $5 million goal I set for tomorrow’s public fundraising deadline. It’s our most ambitious goal yet, but that’s what it’s going to take to win one of the most expensive and competitive Senate races of the cycle. Can you please chip in $5 to keep us on track to flipping this battleground seat and taking back the Senate majority?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1385&amount=5&t=9&akid=3964%2E124072%2EQn87u7)

## The Capitalist exists because of you, and we want to hear from you!
**[Become a paid subscriber today and access the Live Capitalist chat](https://substack.com/redirect/6880ecc6-931a-49c9-9e4b-8c46865f0e4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Subscribe here now](https://substack.com/redirect/6880ecc6-931a-49c9-9e4b-8c46865f0e4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
We like to talk about how much we hate airline travel. I'll admit with several hundred thousand airline miles under my belt, I'm an expert. In fact, I'm writing this in the Denver airport, my 5th connection through Denver this month, and just got a three-hour delay. Yup, I'm an expert.
Much of airline travel is miserable, yes. The entire TSA experience. The lines. Lines for the bathroom. Lines to get a cup of coffee. Lines to get on the escalator to get on a train to get in a line to go up the escalator to get in a line at the gate to get in a line in the jet bridge. It's Soviet.
But what we really hate about the airport and the airlines... what really drives us over the edge... are other people. And people are fixable. The rest is not.
Sorry. I really don't think the TSA or the Airlines / Airports will improve. TSA? Unless we deport Islam and profile people for no-fly lists, TSA will never reform. You think any U.S. President is going to risk another terrorist incident for the sake of improved personal experience and greater individual freedom? It's laughable.
I like Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and was a regular on his FOX Business show before he was nominated to the position. He's a good guy. "One of us." There is no way in hell Duffy is going to risk Mohammed Shabaz Bin Jamar using a flight to secure paradise with 49 virgins and endless falafel by letting TSA be more respectful of human dignity. If anything, his duty is to make it more stringent.

## The Capitalist is a reader-supported publication, we exist for you, because of you!
[Support What We Do](https://substack.com/redirect/6880ecc6-931a-49c9-9e4b-8c46865f0e4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
I am the perfect candidate for proper TSA "reform". I have a very public profile, several decades of tax receipts, zero criminal record, TSA pre-check, CLEAR, Global Entry, and an inactive TS/SCI Full Scope/POLY security clearance (the highest you can get), plus registration on numerous federal (and unconstitutional) gun logs... in a functioning TSA I should be allowed to just walk on a plane. I'm not a threat. The government knows I'm not a threat, but we pretend.
"Anyone can be a Muslim terrorist!" Just like we did with the AIDS scare. "Anyone can get it!" Eh, my dad wasn't too worried...
So, I wait in the TSA line, with my CLEAR, my pre-check, my pre-check touchless (which I don't really understand but it is now the shortest line) and I play the security assessment game. My better half and I were going through Dulles Airport TSA headed to the UK this past summer, and in front of us was a fully covered, just the eyeballs showing person (Man? Woman? Who the hell knows?) and it went through TSA no problem. When I walked through: BEEP! BEEP! "Sir, could you step aside you've been randomly selected for additional screening" and I'm given the TSA officer love grope.
Statistically, who's more likely a threat to the plane? But statistics don't drive our national security. What does? I don't know. No one does. Diversity? Tolerance? Not being called offensive... but none of it makes us safe.
Just imagine asking Artificial Intelligence to run a program on TSA screening. The fastest way to end AI is to have it do unbiased crime stats. It would be run out of town like David Duke in a pickup truck.

## The Capitalist is a reader-supported publication, we exist for you, because of you!
[Support What We Do](https://substack.com/redirect/6880ecc6-931a-49c9-9e4b-8c46865f0e4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
TSA will never change and nor will the airlines. They enjoy one of the best monopolies in business. What forces any industry to improve is competition, and the airlines are eliminating it regularly. I liked USAir. I thought they were the best airline. Easier for American Airlines to buy USAir them than to beat them, and after that merger, the need for American Airlines to improve vanished.
I once flew Virgin America from Dulles to LAX. It was probably one the best coach experiences imaginable in terms of food, comfort, entertainment. One would think it was going to set a new standard in air travel, and it was... until Alaska Airlines bought it, and all of that improved customer experience was eliminated.
Niceties cost money.
No Venture Capitalists are vision-boarding a new airline. There's no airport space, too much government bureaucracy, too much risk and not enough reward. We're stuck. Airlines know we are stuck. Their mottos should be more honest.
United Airlines: _If you don 't like us, then walk to Paris, fatso_
Delta: _You hate us, but we hate you even more_
American Airlines: _You want us to put you on the no-fly list? Then shut the hell up_
Our only option to improve air travel is for people to improve, and that is possible, but it will require a lot of uncomfortable work. Better behaved, better attired, better composed people are possible with discipline, shame, exclusion, and punishment. We can fix air travel if we fix ourselves.

## The Capitalist is a reader-supported publication, we exist for you, because of you!
[Support What We Do](https://substack.com/redirect/6880ecc6-931a-49c9-9e4b-8c46865f0e4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
Let me start with the men. I'll let a lady talk to the ladies. I believe in two genders, as God created, and I'll give advice to my own and encourage ladies to police each other. Especially on the ubiquity of the yoga pants, which roughly only 5% of them should be wearing in yoga studios and 0% at the airport. I will stick to the men and not tell women to stop using arguing with the gate agent who asks them to consolidate a roller bag, purse, tote, backpack and fifth random bag while unable to pull up the boarding pass holding a ginormous coffee cup because she's on a call. No, I'll let women talk to women about that.
Men, I will be clear and blunt. We have a job to do. We are men. We do our duty for the good of society without complaint. Here is what you are going to do to improve the airport experience. Do it. Time for us to set the public example and lead because we are men.
Let's start with attire. "Dress for the job you want" needs to apply to personal airport appearance. Comfort is for children (and apparently all the yoga pants women).
No toes or armpits should ever be visible.
The number of times I've seen a man wearing a mask but standing at an airport urinal in flip flops... here's a good rule: flip flips should be worn to and from water. Wear them to the pool and the beach. Wear them tubing down the river. Wear them after your gym workout to avoid athlete's foot or George Costanza's urination in the shower.
(There's a second Seinfeld reference coming shortly.)
Men don't wear shorts on a plane unless sitting next to their spouse or in a singular row like the United flights on a Bombardier CRJ-550. Men do not press their thigh skin against strangers. "But it's summer". The airplane is 65 degrees. You're fine. In fact, you're better than fine: you're a man. Dress like one.
As bad as shorts are sweatpants. Too many have fallen for the Instagram ad of the handsome, former D-1 athlete saying "these are my new go-to travel sweatpants". He looks great. He is also 6'3'' a 4% body fat and a professional model. Buddy, you're... not. You should not be wearing sweatpants in public.
"Again with the sweatpants?", Jerry Seinfeld asked a slovenly George Costanza. "You know the message you are sending out to the world with these sweatpants? You're telling the world: I give up. I can't compete in normal society. I'm miserable, so I might as well be comfortable".
Men wearing sweatpants in public are admitting they are failures. Dress like you are not George Costanza.
When 16 of us went to Scotland for my buddy's bachelor party, he insisted we all wear jacket and tie on the plane "like old times". Never in history have 16 guys drunk so much and yet made such little noise on an overnight flight. Was it our attire? It definitely contributed. We didn't dress like drunken fools. We dressed like men (who got very drunk like fools).
Wear a collar.
That's a simple rule for airport travel (and all public life as men). Wear a collar. It can be a flannel. It can be a Brooks Brothers oxford. A polo shirt. A plaid, western with snaps. But clothes make the man, and collars make the clothes.
Tee shirts are for work. I wear a tee shirt every day on the farm. I don't wear them to a friend's house for dinner. I don't wear them to a restaurant. And there's no such thing as a "nice" tee shirt. My $15 Costco polo is nicer than your $150 Theory tee shirt. Always.
Then, as men, we must demand those around us act the same. Shame is valuable. Trust me, your friend who shows up to the airport dressed like he's the 6th man on an NBA team will stop dressing like that if you call him out. Basketball shorts and an Allen Iverson jersey? What are you, 14?
Men dressed appropriately are less likely to sprawl out on the floor or lay down across 4 seats at the gate. Men dressed appropriately are less likely to put their feet up like they are in the privacy of their den. And more importantly, men who behave well create a climate of good behavior and dignified composure. One is less likely to have an airport meltdown, the violent and verbal kind which makes the news, when those around them are well-behaved.
Why are you quiet at the library? Because everyone else is. We can do the same at the airport. We just have to be the first ones.
I've never seen an appropriately dressed man disturb others with his FaceTime calls. I've never seen a guy in a collared shirt watch a video without headphones. I've never seen someone who dresses the part stand at the podium and yell about his seat. The properly dressed tend to be the properly behaved, and the properly behaved make air travel tolerable.
The same goes with dining. Concerts. Movies. Performing arts. I'll exempt ball games as most of us wear a Jeeter #2 jersey (you should, regardless of the team or the sport) and raucous behavior is part of the fan experience. It is not part of the flight experience. Dress the part. Dress for success. Dress for job you want, and the job we all want, which will get us a private jet where we can dress however we want. Until then, dress like a man. Then more of us will act like one.

I'll exempt ball games as most of us wear a Jeeter #2 jersey (you should, regardless of the team or the sport) and raucous behavior is part of the fan experience. It is not part of the flight experience. Dress the part. Dress for success. Dress for job you want, and the job we all want, which will get us a private jet where we can dress however we want. Until then, dress like a man. Then more of us will act like one. Daniel Turner is the founder and executive director of Power The Future, a national nonprofit organization that advocates for American energy jobs. He also runs a sheep and cattle farm in rural Virginia. subject: He fled socialism. He won’t denounce it.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY OLLIVANT FOR CONGRESS
body:
He gleefully said he will subpoena anyone who disagreed.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/nnYQHuvzSlZ?e=14c77a6723&c2id=09489c9156c428bed3a67a2822595ae0)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

Friends and Neighbors,
Tomorrow is the FEC deadline. Our campaign is making real strides. Volunteers are knocking doors. Neighbors are waking up. The contrast in this race is becoming impossible to ignore.
Yevgeny Vindman likes to tell the story that his family fled socialism. Fine. Then he should have no trouble denouncing it.
**He won’t.**
Instead, Vindman aligns with the socialist wing of his own party. **That tells you everything you need to know.** The biography is the costume and [_**his voting record** **and the silence are the real man.**_](https://us.list-manage.com/18aEXKIn4c3?e=14c77a6723&c2id=09489c9156c428bed3a67a2822595ae0)
He has also said it flat out: if Democrats take the House, they get subpoena power and he will gleefully stand by this during a second term. That is not a governing agenda. That is a revenge agenda dressed up as “accountability.”
Virginians did not send anyone to Congress to hunt political enemies or play footsie with socialists. They sent someone to fight for families paying more for groceries, gas, and housing. They want secure borders, safer communities, and a government that remembers who it works for.
Vindman’s priority is the swamp. Ours is Virginia.
If we want to finish the job and send him home, we must show strength on this report. _**The other side has a massive war chest. We have something they don’t: a candidate who is not interested in turning Congress into a revenge machine.**_
Chip in before midnight tomorrow so it counts:

[**Donate HERE $500, $250, $100, $50, $25 or chip in whatever you can today**](https://us.list-manage.com/6ZHNmSmrPSW?e=14c77a6723&c2id=09489c9156c428bed3a67a2822595ae0)

Thank you for standing with us.
****

**Republican Nominee for U.S. Congress****Virginia’s 7th Congressional District**

body:
| | | Army veteran Cait Conley is running for Congress in NY-17, one of the most competitive and expensive House districts in the country. These emails are a fundamental part of our campaign's fundraising and organizing efforts, but if you would like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-gP0Xd1LL-Lub7Gk22PHy9kzjPt3sXuNFv6KSE9k7C3KUJacwL8anBo75-Ronj0mecLi0D_3wgjMeuAgozJSA4qNTbrqc5tNcXW2zW2j7JmETmSwJNR3vOLBHL53VFNSoeo1z4VCaFcyJcsty7YfsKs452Ev5Amklxbbf1Xeqp4dwPqqookODFLk5FzYkljwd9M0-jciuJ7loFWiPLBGg8-y_1tYcGCfUxAmEmFcqtBx_xoAoLXM3jv8IXcGEOAJQ-U0rRTumXrWT1IrMt0cCNPu7BCZadfNDPBjRw7HzdpB99tkhheYC0kkwjUynmUy5UYqGGSSc05534BSLdQPNyzJmJve2dEYW840SaVItTYFYir5I86yshMLlLLJaS-7J5xmbOk5jXGpn7_Vd7Z6s-/4ug/Nooyja0rQhixMq6xYDL0sw/h0/h001.iHrf3Kt18xK9nJVLmLnEy4ofl7UKfYI1PBzhPSAH9gY)
---
Peter, it’s Emily — Cait’s campaign manager. Tomorrow at midnight is our campaign’s last quarterly FEC fundraising deadline. I’ll level with you: We could really use your help meeting this goal. If we want to flip NY-17, we cannot afford to fall short. [If that’s all you need to hear, I’m respectfully asking you to help us meet our goals. Thank you for your generous support.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqiBIysd_1t7dQL51NYrcyAfGXt4NM-NrFmFgQbUn1YlVWrBGw_ds9jRXKPBD2KIf8hahF23J7ZSpX6XCr-pkWC_Y8m2SVUiwx8QIfzv7eGOUxw4h6W2su2FX3JIcasQGUdDvzZQ6XfgvR4CHOajYj65RMjC9C68TIvzzp2dK-PRhj65c5aVSuBCHDLSVx13ycptcf-A7jnjyBGocCa416wyftVIYb_duSliNaLNR51UsnnH-Lbe8xkWMm-beR6Dmfradr-DdZLtzflrhUqmUXHB5hyy3rtEyDgbmi5kKZ0pBihVj1hmPWgX5I9gZGf9YBSOcznlkc7_JudYHzZPAM/4ug/Nooyja0rQhixMq6xYDL0sw/h1/h001.x-1Pubd92u1xk4QL2b-51frT6w3mFmMhcYTGibpnA8U) But if you need to hear a little more, I’ve prepared this memo to give you a full picture. | **TO:** Peter
**FROM:** Cait Conley for NY-17
**MEMO:** September FEC Deadline **** **_NY-17 is one of only three districts nationwide that split their ticket in 2024 for Kamala Harris and a Republican member of Congress._** Mike Lawler is beatable. This is a winnable district. But we are in the fight of our lives. All polls show we can win this as long as we reach voters. Mike Lawler has already massively outspent us on TV ads, and Donald Trump is spending more on this race than he is on any other House race nationwide. They’re spending so much money because they are afraid. Mike Lawler has beaten two politicians before. But he’s never beaten a patriot like Cait. And he’s never faced a campaign like this before! We’ve already knocked over 50,000 doors and made over 300,000 calls reaching voters and mobilizing an unstoppable field force. **_About Cait:_** Cait Conley is a proud fourth-generation Hudson Valley native from a blue collar family. After graduating from West Point, she spent 16 years as an active duty Army officer, deploying six times overseas to keep America safe. She’s spent her entire career protecting Americans and taking on tough fights. She has what it takes to beat Lawler and flip this district. **_Tomorrow's deadline:_** Tomorrow is our last quarterly FEC deadline. After tomorrow, we’ll need to publicly report how much we’ve raised, and from how many donors. New York is the single most expensive place to run a political campaign – and Nate Silver has called NY-17 one of the three most likely seats to determine control of the House. So every pundit in the country is going to be watching our report to see if we’ve raised enough money to compete and win here. **_Where you come in:_** Our campaign isn’t like Lawler’s — we’re powered by everyday people chipping in what they can afford, when they can afford it. **The bottom line: The only way we’ll be able to raise the funds to run a competitive campaign is with your help.**
---
If we want to take back the House, we need the biggest grassroots team possible.

The mountains, the rivers, the small towns, the small businesses. That is home. After Helene, we stood in the mud and rubble and watched promises fall short. That storm cost our community about $60 billion. We’ve gotten less than 15% of what we need to recover. That felt like a real failure to me. **I was frustrated by politics for a long time.** But I also think that if you’re frustrated, you can either complain or you can do something about it. I’m choosing to do something and to build something real. I know how to build things. I know how to get a deal done. Even though running for Congress wasn’t always the plan, when I travel through our communities and see families still waiting for help from leaders who couldn’t get results, staying on the sidelines just doesn’t make sense. We deserve a representative who shows up and fights for Western North Carolina. My family’s farm has been here for generations. We run a business that employs our neighbors. I have 25 employees. clean_body: But here’s why I am If you’d like to unsubscribe, | = Peter, I love Western North Carolina. The mountains, the rivers, the small towns, the small businesses. That is home. After Helene, we stood in the mud and rubble and watched promises fall short. That storm cost our community about $60 billion. We’ve gotten less than 15% of what we need to recover. That felt like a real failure to me. I was frustrated by politics for a long time. But I also think that if you’re frustrated, you can either complain or you can do something about it. I’m choosing to do something and to build something real. I know how to build things. I know how to get a deal done. Even though running for Congress wasn’t always the plan, when I travel through our communities and see families still waiting for help from leaders who couldn’t get results, staying on the sidelines just doesn’t make sense. We deserve a representative who shows up and fights for Western North Carolina. My family’s farm has been here for generations. We run a business that employs our neighbors. I have 25 employees. Their political stances don’t matter to me — they’re my people, and service is what we do. Chuck Edwards has had enough chances to fight for this region. He has failed us. We deserve better. Dear Friend, Tomorrow at midnight, we close the books on the final full fundraising quarter before Election Day. For our campaign, this deadline comes at an important moment. We are entering the final five weeks of this race, and every dollar we raise now helps us reach voters across Pennsylvania's 14th Congressional District -- through advertising, voter contact, organizing, and the work our volunteers are doing every day across Southwestern Pennsylvania. **This deadline matters for another reason, too.** After the quarter ends, our campaign is required to publicly report what we've raised and spent. It will be one of the final financial snapshots of this campaign before Election Day -- a public measure of the support and resources we've built heading into the final weeks. We want that report to reflect what we've seen on the ground across this district: a growing campaign with people who believe Southwestern Pennsylvania deserves a representative who will listen to them and put their interests first. That's why Alan Bradstock decided to run. Alan grew up in Donora, graduated from Washington & Jefferson College, served our country as a U.S. Army aviation officer during Desert Storm, and spent more than 20 years as an FBI Special Agent. Southwestern Pennsylvania isn't just the district he's running to represent. It's home. Over the past several months, Alan has traveled across PA-14 holding town halls and talking with working families, veterans, union members, small-business owners, students, and community leaders. He has listened to people talk about the challenges they face and what they expect from the person they send to Congress. clean_body: | | Dear Friend, Tomorrow at midnight, we close the books on the final full fundraising quarter before Election Day. For our campaign, this deadline comes at an important moment. We are entering the final five weeks of this race, and every dollar we raise now helps us reach voters across Pennsylvania's 14th Congressional District -- through advertising, voter contact, organizing, and the work our volunteers are doing every day across Southwestern Pennsylvania. This deadline matters for another reason, too. After the quarter ends, our campaign is required to publicly report what we've raised and spent. It will be one of the final financial snapshots of this campaign before Election Day -- a public measure of the support and resources we've built heading into the final weeks. We want that report to reflect what we've seen on the ground across this district: a growing campaign with people who believe Southwestern Pennsylvania deserves a representative who will listen to them and put their interests first. That's why Alan Bradstock decided to run. Alan grew up in Donora, graduated from Washington & Jefferson College, served our country as a U.S. Army aviation officer during Desert Storm, and spent more than 20 years as an FBI Special Agent. Southwestern Pennsylvania isn't just the district he's running to represent. It's home. Over the past several months, Alan has traveled across PA-14 holding town halls and talking with working families, veterans, union members, small-business owners, students, and community leaders. He has listened to people talk about the challenges they face and what they expect from the person they send to Congress. Now we need to make sure more voters have the opportunity to hear from Alan before they cast their ballots. Can you make a contribution today to help us finish this quarter strong and give Alan the resources he needs for the final five weeks of this campaign? ~~ Whether it's $10, $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford, every contribution helps us reach more voters. We have until 11:59 PM tomorrow night to add to our end-of-quarter total. A strong finish will help show the grassroots support behind Alan's campaign while giving us the resources we need to reach voters in the final stretch. Thank you for standing with Alan and helping us build this campaign across Southwestern Pennsylvania. -Team Bradstock ~~ P.S. We need more than contributions to win this race -- we need people. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Something I believe with every bone in my body:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
I do not expect that you will donate to every email we send. That would be way too much! But if you can afford to chip in today, I want to take a moment to share why this is the moment to show everyone watching what we are made of.
**September 30th marks the end of our fundraising quarter.**
As a federal campaign, we have to share how much we raise on Wednesday night. Our political opponents, pundits, and reporters will be watching our numbers closely to gauge how strong this movement can be.
**The amount of money we raise signals the passion behind our policy demands to everybody watching.** When we say we need Medicare for All or a living wage, and that message is coming from more than a hundred thousand people across the country, we force the establishment to take us seriously.
When you see the modern-day barons who control the media companies and the algorithms ramp up their attacks on this campaign, it is because they take us seriously and they are scared of our momentum.
They are afraid of our power. And they know that we can beat their big money when we work together.
**Our power comes from the belief that when working people come together, we can create a better future for us all.**
When people like you chip in small amounts, together we are able to stand up to the powerful and win. I believe that with every bone in my body.
[ Right now, we are $226,000 short of our end-of-quarter fundraising goal — the number that will be one of the main signifiers of our strength. Can you give $5, or any amount that makes sense for you, to show that our movement is not going anywhere?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260929.tYAuDE&refcode=em20260929-12367-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=12367%2E2526796%2EoPWDc-)

Whether you can give today or just read along, I am grateful for your support — it is not something I take for granted.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

| | | Hi, it’s Congressman Darren Soto.

I’m sure you’re getting a lot of fundraising emails from different campaigns right now claiming that the sky will fall if you don’t rush a donation right away to their campaign.

**I’m not going to do that. Instead, I’ll just give you five reasons why a $5 donation from you to me would be impactful before tomorrow's end-of-quarter FEC deadline.**
1. I’m running for reelection in _**one of the toughest seats**_ in the country. Ever since I took office, I have been committed to serving Central Florida in my seat. But now, because of Republicans’ redistricting effort, I am in a much more challenging district, and I need your help to keep fighting for Central Florida.
2. Democrats have a chance to win back the House majority this year! But we’re not going to do that if we can’t protect the seats that are already blue – so _**the path to the House majority relies on protecting this seat.**_
3. If we win the House majority, we can finally make progress on _**key Democratic priorities**_ that Republicans have been stymying for years.
4. _**I am facing my final FEC quarterly deadline before Election Day.**_ We have an important opportunity to show the strength of our campaign, so I’ve set a goal of raising $10,000 between now and tomorrow night.
5. I’m counting on $5 or $10 donations from folks like you to help me reach my goal before the end of the quarter tomorrow – so I need _**all hands on deck.**_

New Mexico's race for governor won't have a debate, and the candidate who's ahead doesn't seem worried about it.
[Jay McCleskey joined us to explain why she might be right](https://us.list-manage.com/EjRR3qnE_f8?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e), and what that tells you about how rough this fall could be for Republicans everywhere.
Plus big storms are working through New Mexico - Mark has the forecast. Parts of the state could get six inches of rain!
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/4gk1Ws_vWDj?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🔥 **HAALAND WALKS AWAY FROM THE DEBATES**
Deb Haaland’s campaign offered Gregg Hull three possible debate dates in mid-October and gave him 48 hours to choose one. Hull declined those dates, while Haaland dismissed the back-and-forth over scheduling as a “sideshow.”

Jay’s take is that challengers generally benefit from as many debates as they can get — particularly when they’re trying to close a fundraising or name-recognition gap. His rule is pretty simple: If you’re the challenger, take the debate whenever and wherever you can get it. If your opponent asks you to debate in her kitchen in half an hour, the answer should probably be, “I’ll be right there.”

We also read the first six paragraphs of the Albuquerque Journal’s coverage on air because the disagreement over scheduling quickly became difficult to follow. Both campaigns offered their own accounts of what happened, leaving readers to sort through competing claims about who offered — or rejected — which dates.

🎤 **THE RUNNING MATES DID DEBATE, AND IT WENT BADLY FOR GALLEGOS**
Democrat Stephanie Garcia Richard and Republican David Gallegos debated at the Journal last Thursday. Jeff Tucker, a Republican who writes for the paper, said she was sharp. He said Gallegos wore jeans and kept his hands in his pockets.
Then Gallegos said President Trump "doesn't understand New Mexico." Our first thought was that Haaland's campaign could mail that line to every Republican in the state and keep some of them home.
Gallegos is also running his own attack ad against Haaland, and Jay explains why that makes national Republicans less likely to send money here.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/186ArURwVq2?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
🏛️ **8 SENATE RACES, ALL WITHIN A FEW POINTS**
Maine, Ohio, Iowa, Texas, New Hampshire, Michigan, Minnesota and South Carolina are all close. Mark says which ones Republicans can still win.
We also play the moment a Persian student asked Michigan Democrat Abdul El-Sayed to stand against Iran's regime. His answer is the reason Mark says Republicans can't afford to lose that seat.

🌧️ **UP TO SIX INCHES OF RAIN IS HEADED FOR NEW MEXICO**
What's left of Hurricane Polo is coming in first, and a big storm from Arizona is right behind it. Mark says Albuquerque could get a couple of inches of rain this week, and parts of Colfax County could get six.
The high peaks near Wheeler Peak could get their first snow of the season, and Mark sees another hurricane lining up for next week. We had a dry summer, and the fall is making up for it.

A devastating collapse could be coming for Democrats in Michigan this November.

No, not in the U.S. Senate race. In a race far fewer people are paying attention to: the Michigan Supreme Court.

Two pro-democracy justices, Megan Cavanagh and Noah Hood, are up for reelection. Both are facing competitive races against MAGA-backed challengers.
State Supreme Courts are crucial for protecting democracy. When MAGA tries to toss out ballots, these courts stop them. When politicians draw rigged maps, these courts throw them out. When extremists come for abortion rights, these courts are the last line of defense.

Billionaires are spending to shape November’s elections. Check your registration, then help OnePA organize. | |

Peter, **Election Day is 5 weeks away, and billionaires are spending to decide whose voices matter when it arrives. In Pennsylvania, billionaire Jeffrey Yass has spent more than $80 million influencing elections. One in 3 state legislators has taken his money.** Yass uses his fortune to back politicians who will advance his agenda, including diverting public dollars toward private schools. His money gives him access to lawmakers while families across Pennsylvania fight for fully funded schools, affordable housing, and the services our communities depend on. He is one example of what happens across the country when billionaires get to turn their wealth into political power. **They can buy ads and write checks. We build power by bringing people together, making sure our neighbors have the information they need to vote, and holding elected officials accountable to the communities they represent.** [**But first, check your voter registration. Confirm that your name and address are current, and make any updates before your state’s deadline. clean_body: Billionaires are spending to shape November’s elections. Check your registration, then help OnePA organize. | | Peter, Election Day is 5 weeks away, and billionaires are spending to decide whose voices matter when it arrives. In Pennsylvania, billionaire Jeffrey Yass has spent more than $80 million influencing elections. One in 3 state legislators has taken his money. Yass uses his fortune to back politicians who will advance his agenda, including diverting public dollars toward private schools. His money gives him access to lawmakers while families across Pennsylvania fight for fully funded schools, affordable housing, and the services our communities depend on. He is one example of what happens across the country when billionaires get to turn their wealth into political power. They can buy ads and write checks. We build power by bringing people together, making sure our neighbors have the information they need to vote, and holding elected officials accountable to the communities they represent. | | | OnePA members are talking with neighbors, sharing trusted voting information, and developing leaders in working-class and Black communities. We are connecting the decisions made at the ballot box to the fights our families face every day, from school funding to the cost of living. That means making sure people know where to turn if their registration needs updating, helping neighbors make a plan to vote, and having conversations about what’s at stake in their own communities. Each of those conversations brings someone else into the work of deciding what happens after Election Day, too. Yass can spend millions trying to get politicians to answer his calls. Every person we organize helps build a movement that can demand answers from those same politicians. We have 5 weeks to reach more people and make our communities’ priorities heard. He is a partisan progressive who would enter the Senate as a guaranteed vote for every item on Schumer's wish list. He is betting that a well-funded, nationally backed campaign can override decades of trust Susan has earned with the people of Maine.[Three opponents. One coordinated plan. Millions in outside money are flooding into all three states simultaneously.](https://trk.email.goprelease._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjYwOTI5X0xYLVRELjExNDUxMF90MjAzOTgzNS0xMTQyJmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDkyOV9MWC1URC4xMTQ1MTBfdDIwMzk4MzUtMTE0MiZ4aWQ9VjEuWGlQam5JcWUtdHJUT0hjMkZmZFloUmRFVTZDY0U5cE1uZ0pRM3I5VHBBRUEyNlFKdmpRZE12M0h3QWw5SFI4biJ9/3BW-q7H6z02ee6i3bFemhg)This is the most targeted, deliberate assault on the Republican Senate majority we have seen. Schumer isn't hoping to pick off one seat on the margins. He is going after all three of us -- at the same time -- because he knows that if he wins all three, it's over.We cannot let that happen. But we cannot stop it without you.

I am so proud to represent Delaware and Delawareans.

Over the past week, you may have seen that Nancy Mace has once again been tweeting about my gender identity. On top of that, my Republican opponent in this year’s election has doubled down on his petty comments, and the Delaware GOP is backing him up.
The truth is that Republicans want to make this election about my gender identity because they _don’t_ have any ideas to offer Americans on how to lower costs and make life more affordable.

name: Carole King
subject: We need Chris in the Senate
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260929_3.1fu13u&refcode=em20260929-3&t=1001&akid=9218%2E582294%2E1FAVZA ]Carole King

Hi, it’s
Carole King 🎶, and I personally wrote this email.

Chris Pappas has been serving New Hampshire’s first district in the U.S.
House of Representatives. Now he’s running to serve every Granite Stater
in the U.S. Senate.

I know Chris personally. He is worthy.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260929_3.1fu13u&refcode=em20260929-3&t=1002&akid=9218%2E582294%2E1FAVZA ]If that’s all you need to read to support Chris’s campaign, click here
to donate now, and have a great rest of your day!

John E. Sununu is Chris’s opponent. If elected, he would likely join other
Senate Republicans in voting for whatever the person in the White House
wants no matter how irrational or illogical or corrupt.

And if an opening occurred on the Supreme Court, Sununu would likely
confirm the president’s nominee for another justice to take more of our
rights away.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260929_3.1fu13u&refcode=em20260929-3&t=1003&akid=9218%2E582294%2E1FAVZA ]Will you give $1, $5, or whatever you can afford right now to help
Chris earn the votes of more people in New Hampshire?

Chris Pappas will vote to lift the weight of worries that the president
keeps adding to and that the Republican Senate majority has enabled.

And the Republican Senate majority has failed to stop the president from
spending OUR tax dollars building vanity projects, destroying buildings
that belong to all of us, and profiting from the power of his office.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260929_3.1fu13u&refcode=em20260929-3&t=1004&akid=9218%2E582294%2E1FAVZA ]We need Chris in the Senate to say NO to the president’s whiplash
whims.

We don’t know whether Sununu would have voted for the resolution directing
the President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran. But
we do know that Chris Pappas has consistently voted YES to bring our
military family members home.

John E. Sununu and his family appear to have a close relationship with
power and money and maybe not as close with everyday people.

Chris Pappas IS everyday people. And that’s why he needs our help to pay
for gas to travel around the state and earn the votes of Granite Staters
wherever they are.

Will you join me in helping Chris reach more voters?
[If your number isn’t in a box, click OTHER and enter your amount.]

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260929_3.1fu13u&amount=5&refcode=em20260929-3&t=1023&akid=9218%2E582294%2E1FAVZA ]Donate $5 »

Chris is
gaining momentum — but the super-wealthy Republican donors are spending
even more money to turn their wave of negative ads into an October
tsunami.

In campaign world, end-of-quarter reports are important to show strength.
If you and other recipients of this email donate whatever you can afford
right now, Chris’s campaign will be on track to release an impressive EOQ
report at the end of this month.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260929_3.1fu13u&refcode=em20260929-3&t=1024&akid=9218%2E582294%2E1FAVZA ]With September 30th less than a week away, will you help Chris’s
campaign build more momentum?

Whether you donate or not, here are two other ways you can support Chris
for free.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/695?t=1025&akid=9218%2E582294%2E1FAVZA ]Vote.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/signup/take_action_pappas_campaign/?source=em20260929-3&t=1026&akid=9218%2E582294%2E1FAVZA ]Volunteer.

I know it’s hard to feel hopeful with so many people
struggling, and it’s even harder if
you’re among them. But hope may lie in the growing movement to replace
corruption and depravity with hope and humanity.

Thank you for participating in whatever ways you can. We can do this.

With my best wishes to you and your family,

- Carole

Carole King is a singer-songwriter, author, and activist. Her
distinctions include a Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award, a Kennedy
Center Honor, and double-induction into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.
Now Carole is using her platform to help elect candidates who are
running to lift and improve the lives of their fellow Americans. And she
really did write this email.

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.chrispappas.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=9218%2E582294%2E1FAVZA

Hey folks,
There's a fight happening inside MAGA over what comes after Donald Trump--and J.D. Vance is already positioning himself for it.
In this episode, I break down the growing signs that Vance and the people around him are trying to create distance from Trump while publicly staying loyal. Peter Thiel. Ann Coulter. The Iran war. The leaks. The early maneuvering around 2028. It's all starting to connect.

* [**00:03:38**] The 2028 positioning begins as Vance's allies start building a political identity separate from Trump.
* [**00:05:23**] A Politico report puts Vance at the center of an anonymous-source controversy involving the administration and Iran.
* [**00:08:02**] Ann Coulter starts making the case that Vance shouldn't take the blame for Trump's Iran policy.
* [**00:12:01**] Vance gets pressed on soaring gas prices, Iran, and what Americans are being asked to absorb.

The bigger question here is what happens when Trump's allies start thinking seriously about a post-Trump Republican Party. Vance wants to inherit the movement without inheriting all of Trump's baggage. This episode is about the people helping him try--and why Democrats need to understand that strategy before 2028.

name: True the Vote
subject: I am the evidence
body:
Real stories. Lived experience. Undeniable evidence.
| | | September 29, 2026 | [**Read Online**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/lmu2rmld6efmhnpdz9mt6h8ded63qtgh4dogv/dpheh0he28gkkpfmh4/aHR0cHM6Ly9ja2FyY2hpdmUuY29tL2IvcDl1ZWg5aDJlcGwwd3VtNmdndzZrYXBtb203dnphcmhyNDgwZQ==) |
---

Friends,
Yesterday, I asked you to start close to home by checking your own voter record. Today, I want you to meet someone who can tell you why that matters.
Her name is Melissa Love, and she is one of the Detroit residents featured in _Trapped: Detroit._
She didn’t know until she looked. Then she took action.
“I am the evidence,” Melissa said. “They stole my vote from me.”
Think about discovering that your name was being used to cast votes you knew nothing about. Who requested those ballots? Whose signatures were on the paperwork? How could this happen without you knowing?
Those questions deserve answers. Melissa deserves answers.
And her story should make every one of us look at our own record — including people who don’t vote and don’t believe they are even registered.
In Michigan and other automatic voter registration states, all social service programs, such as applying for or renewing a driver’s license, can also register an eligible person to vote unless they know to opt out.
And someone who doesn’t know they are registered may never think to check what is being recorded in their name.
We need to get this message to hundreds of thousands of people in Detroit and millions across the country. To the people who vote in every election, and to the people who say, “This doesn’t concern me. I don’t vote.”
Please check anyway. And then — please vote.
Through [**Mobilize A Million**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/lmu2rmld6efmhnpdz9mt6h8ded63qtgh4dogv/7qh7h8h9xw788etzh6/aHR0cHM6Ly9tb2JpbGl6ZWFtaWxsaW9uLm9yZy8=) we can raise awareness, equip people to review their records, and help them document and report what they find. Our goal is to reach every voter, with each person who checks helping someone else do the same.
Start with [**Scan.Check.Protect.**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/lmu2rmld6efmhnpdz9mt6h8ded63qtgh4dogv/owhkhqhw0gvnnzsvhr/aHR0cHM6Ly9zY2FuY2hlY2twcm90ZWN0Lm9yZy8=) Review your own record. Ask your family and friends to review theirs. When something doesn’t match what you know to be true, document it and report it. Don’t assume someone else will catch it.
Watch Melissa’s story: “I am the evidence.”
[](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/lmu2rmld6efmhnpdz9mt6h8ded63qtgh4dogv/3oh97k58hkh3k4lr96srhn/aHR0cHM6Ly9ydW1ibGUuY29tL3Y3ZncwdXctbWVsaXNzYS1sb3ZlLWktYW0tdGhlLWV2aWRlbmNlLmh0bWw=)_"I am the evidence" - Listen to Melissa Love, of Detroit, MI, recount her experience of learning mail-in ballots were cast in her name without her knowledge._
---
This is why we made _Trapped: Detroit._ People like Melissa deserve to be heard, and the rest of us need to understand why checking our own records matters.
Watch her story. Share it. Then join [**Mobilize A Million**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/lmu2rmld6efmhnpdz9mt6h8ded63qtgh4dogv/7qh7h8h9xw788etzh6/aHR0cHM6Ly9tb2JpbGl6ZWFtaWxsaW9uLm9yZy8=)**** and help us turn that awareness into action.
**Wake up. Equip. Mobilize.**
For Freedom,
Sarah

As Paul’s Campaign Manager, we’ve spent a lot of time together. | | | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140247665/649995450/524014055?refcode=20260929&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTgyNDQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWI4YTc3ZDUtNGFiYy1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=3oe-cjNqUuUtQqOIhUZMZwXLQeHy_MgT57l6PA0dnBM=)

Hey Peter,
---
If you haven’t heard from me before, my name is CJ, and I am Paul’s Campaign Manager. That means that I spend a lot of time following him around and making sure we get where we need to go. It also means that I have a pretty good idea of who Paul is. Just the other day, we met up to exchange some stuff at a grocery store parking lot- boring, I know. One thing I have to tell you about Paul is that he is not afraid to talk to anyone in any situation. While we were in the parking lot, a woman came up to us and asked if we would hang out with her until she could reach the store manager because a customer inside was harassing her. Of course, Paul said he would wait with her. We had a wonderful conversation with her about how things were going for her, and Paul listened. He then told her he was running for Congress so we could make those changes a reality. That’s just who Paul is. He listens to people, no matter the situation, and is ready to step up and take action the moment someone needs it. Since he’s running for office, this is the side of him that I think people miss, because it isn’t always shown in a photo or in an advertisement. I know that this instinct will carry with him into every vote that he takes in Congress. But I need to be real with you for a second. Brad Knott has PACs, and a lot of wealthy family members ready to bankroll this campaign for him. Paul’s running this race on donations from grassroots supporters like you, and **_we need your_** **_help_** to beat Brad. With your help, we can keep hosting events throughout the district to meet people where they are and inform voters about the critical election coming up this November. Tomorrow is our largest fundraising deadline yet – our final regular quarterly reporting deadline before Election Day. **Can I ask you to please chip in $5, $10, or $25 to help keep Paul’s campaign going strong? [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

I'm Mai Vang — a Justice Democrats-endorsed candidate for Congress in
California's 7th District, a daughter of Hmong refugees, and a Sacramento
City Councilmember who's spent my life fighting for working families.

We've created a little tradition on our campaign.

At canvass launches, house parties, or before our volunteers head out to
knock doors, I call out two words: "OUR TIME!"

And the room calls back: "MAI TIME!"

It started as a small thing, but it's come to mean everything to me — a
reminder that this campaign is about all of us, and what we can do when
working people decide to organize.

So you can imagine what it meant when the primary winners of the Justice
Democrats slate — Chris Rabb, Melat Kiros, Claire Valdez, Adam Hamaway,
Darializa Avila Chevalier, and Donavan McKinney — came together to say the
same thing: that it's Mai Time.

January. And they all want @MaiForUs there with them. Help her beat a
billionaire: maiforus.com/donate

These are candidates who all won their own fights against the
establishment. Every one of them ran the kind of race I'm running —
refusing corporate money, running unapologetically on Medicare for All, on
ending the genocide in Gaza, and on taking on the billionaire class.

And by staying true to those values, every single one of them won.

I'm up next, and this is the toughest race left on the board. I'm facing a
21-year incumbent with a corporate super PAC already spending hundreds of
thousands of dollars to tear us down. The establishment is desperate for
this slate's winning streak to end with me.

Mai Vang

clean_body: Trump's Super PAC just reserved over $800,000 to save Jen Kiggans in CD2. Our momentum is proving that these seats are not safe bets for the GOP. | = Peter, Our momentum is making one thing clear: these seats are no longer safe bets for the GOP, and they are shaking. Up until now, ad spending in CD2 was dead even. But Donald Trump’s Super PAC just dropped $800,000 in broadcast TV time to bail out Jen Kiggans, threatening to hand Republicans a massive airwave advantage in the final stretch if we do not respond immediately. Republicans thought they could coast through Virginia without a real fight. Now they are panicking because Shannon Taylor is within a single point in CD1, Elaine Luria is closing in on Kiggans in CD2, and national outlets have just reported that Perriello's CD5 is shifting blue. They know their candidates are on defense. But a wave of TV ads does not win an election. Real people on front porches do. We have 24 hours left in Q3 to close our budget gap and lock in October payroll for our field organizers across CD1, CD2, and CD5. | | | | Growing up, church taught me something simple: we are here to serve others.

Political scientists call it relational organizing. **_Out here that 's just knowing your neighbors._** That is the movement we spent over a year building. Our volunteers work their own blocks, their own churches, and their own kids' schools, so when they ask a neighbor to vote, it comes as a favor between friends instead of a pitch from a stranger. We show up at virtually every community event and the occasional Friday night lights. We talk with ranchers over a fence rail and with young parents in the school pickup line. clean_body: | | Peter, James Talarico joined us in our district this week and told a packed room what our campaign has been saying for months: Collin County is the key to flipping Texas blue. | We couldn't agree more, but hearing it from the man at the top of our ticket meant a great deal. And what a campaign he is running. He draws crowds Ken Paxton could never dream of, and a marquee Senate race like his pulls casual voters off the couch - the folks who skip midterms but turn out when something big is on the line, and this year something VERY big is on the line. Once they are in the booth, they fill out the whole ballot, and this campaign rises right along. And it works the other way too. The voters nobody polls, the folks who gave up on politics years ago, need more of a personal reason than a big statewide race to give the process another shot. Political scientists call it relational organizing. Out here that 's just knowing your neighbors. That is the movement we spent over a year building. Our volunteers work their own blocks, their own churches, and their own kids' schools, so when they ask a neighbor to vote, it comes as a favor between friends instead of a pitch from a stranger. We show up at virtually every community event and the occasional Friday night lights. We talk with ranchers over a fence rail and with young parents in the school pickup line. Our volunteers and campaign staff collect school supplies for kids, and gather necessities for the most vulnerable in our community. In other words, we put service and community ahead of politics, and folks really notice. James drives the big turnout wave. We reach the voters no wave can touch. Do both at once, and Collin County goes blue, and when Collin County goes blue, Texas follows. _**Cliff 's Note:**_
##### Alabama drivers are paying more than $6 for diesel. Their senator, who wants to be their next governor, told CNN they're happy to pay it. Then he went to the Senate floor to warn America about furries flying our airplanes.
##### You can't make this up, and David Shuster doesn't have to. He brings the receipts: the floor speech, the Community Note that fact-checked it in real time, the actual research on the furry fandom, and the gas prices Tuberville would rather you not think about. It's funny as hell, and it's the whole MAGA playbook in one speech: when you can't fix people's problems, invent a scarier enemy.
##### [This is what your membership pays for: reporting that takes these clowns apart with facts and still makes you laugh. If you're not a paid member yet, now's the time](https://substack.com/redirect/a117ba88-e31d-4320-b9b2-508c675e46df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

_**-- Cliff**_
* * *
_**by David Shuster**_
There are moments in the U.S. Senate when the "world's greatest deliberative body," as it has been called, brings attention to the leading issues of our time and the questions upon which civilization itself depends. Republican Senator Tommy Tuberville of Alabama just showed us his priority: Furries.
Yes, while gasoline in Alabama is over $4.10 a gallon and diesel has climbed above $6, while families are being squeezed by an affordability crisis, and while the United States wrestles with the economic and technological consequences of artificial intelligence, Senator Tommy Tuberville recently took to the Senate floor to warn us about people who dress up as anthropomorphic animals.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.NqjrsKk3riDrjN_TIIw1Cs4yR4B0u0Nzqm9UuVPdIIw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=217916439)
One trembles to imagine what would have happened had Tuberville discovered the existence of Comic-Con. But I digress. During a Sept. 22 Senate floor speech, Tuberville spent several minutes thunderously condemning transgenderism and what he called the "furry community."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a117ba88-e31d-4320-b9b2-508c675e46df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
He declared that research shows 25 percent of furries are "gender confused," and then announced an even more terrifying discovery: many airline pilots, flight attendants and air-traffic controllers are supposedly furries.
"Lord help us," the senator exclaimed.
Indeed. Lord help us.
Especially those of us who were hoping that the people flying airplanes had been selected according to such quaint criteria as training, licensing, experience and competence rather than whether they own a fox costume.
Tuberville offered no evidence that a significant number of aviation professionals are furries, much less that furry fandom has anything whatsoever to do with aviation safety.
Tuberville then posted excerpts of his Senate floor speech on X.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a117ba88-e31d-4320-b9b2-508c675e46df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
His post quickly got slapped with a community note as readers added context they thought people might want to know. Quote: Airline pilots must meet 1st-class medical requirements; being a part of the furry fandom or playing dress-up is not listed in 14 CFR 67.107(c) as a disqualifier. Hiring is entirely merit-based per OpSpec A134; Airlines will hire whomever is qualified and certified.
Tuberville's underlying statistical claim about furries and the transgender community was also off. DurScience, a research organization studying the furry fandom, reported 12.2 percent identifying as transgender in one study.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a117ba88-e31d-4320-b9b2-508c675e46df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
More recent studies find that roughly one-quarter to one-third of respondents do not identify primarily as cisgender--a category that includes identities beyond simply "transgender."
But facts are such inconvenient creatures. They lack the dramatic possibilities of a conservative senator imagining himself boarding an airplane and suddenly realizing that the captain might own a fur suit.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a117ba88-e31d-4320-b9b2-508c675e46df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Perhaps this will be new category in national security.
The Russians have spies. China has industrial espionage. Iran has missiles. Artificial intelligence threatens to end humanity. And Tommy Tuberville has discovered Captain Foxington in the cockpit.
Tuberville is leaving the U.S. Senate and running for Governor of Alabama. So, his effort to demonize the transgender community, or anybody who is LGBTQ, is a political gambit of sorts. Still, even for the Alabama voters who are terrified of the dozen or so NCAA athletes who are trans out of the 500,000 total NCAA athletes, one imagines most Alabamians have more immediate concerns than the sexual orientation of a pilot or what outfits and costumes the pilot, flight attendant, and controller may own.

Republican Senator Tommy Tuberville of Alabama just showed us his priority: Furries. Yes, while gasoline in Alabama is over $4.10 a gallon and diesel has climbed above $6, while families are being squeezed by an affordability crisis, and while the United States wrestles with the economic and technological consequences of artificial intelligence, Senator Tommy Tuberville recently took to the Senate floor to warn us about people who dress up as anthropomorphic animals. "Lord help us," the senator exclaimed. Indeed. Lord help us. # If you live in Idaho this is for you
### Get out and vote. Otherwise, stop complaining.
| | | [Brian Lenney](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---
| Sep 29
---
| [](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---
The election's coming up on November 3rd, and early voting in Canyon County opens October 19th (check with your county clerk for yours).
You can also request an absentee ballot and mail it in early.
No matter what you do, though...
_**Make sure you check your sample ballot before you mail in the real one or show up on Election Day to vote in person.**_
Just click [this link](https://substack.com/redirect/9f118789-011e-4807-83c9-f0d62cd0f08e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), enter your info, and you'll see exactly what's on your ballot.
It's an exact copy to help you prepare at home so you don't feel flustered at the polls (you need to do this because every ballot in Idaho is different depending on your address).
So, before you do anything, [check your sample ballot here](https://substack.com/redirect/9f118789-011e-4807-83c9-f0d62cd0f08e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
There are a few races that'll be on everybody's ballot, like governor and Congress. My advice is to vote for the most conservative person in each race, obviously.
And that's almost always the Republican.
And while I'm tempted to punish weak, needlessly cowardly Republicans in the general election, _**that should be saved for the primaries**_. We can't afford to put Democrats or wacky Libertarians into office because we're mad at our Republican representatives.
_The trade-off just isn 't worth it._
But what I really want you to know about are the four questions at the end of your ballot, because they're the ones people get confused by.
Being a conservative means we conserve things. Our culture, our language, and our respect for life are what set Idaho apart from every liberal state around us. Three of these ballot questions decide whether we keep them:
1. **HJR 4: Only the Legislature can legalize drugs.**

This amends the Idaho Constitution so only the Legislature can legalize marijuana, narcotics, or other psychoactive drugs. Legalization could no longer come through a ballot initiative.
**
I 'm voting: YES.**

Look at our neighbors. Washington, Oregon, Nevada, and Montana all legalized recreational marijuana, and all four did it by ballot initiative. Oregon went furthest. In 2020 an initiative decriminalized hard drugs like fentanyl and meth, Portland's streets filled with open drug use, and by 2024 even Oregon's own liberal legislature had to walk it back.

_Every one of those campaigns was bankrolled by a drug industry that figured out it 's cheaper to buy signature drives than to win over a legislature._

Idaho is one of the last holdouts in the West, and that industry wants us next. I'd rather this decision sit with legislators you can look in the eye and vote out. Out-of-state money never has to answer to you.
* * *
2. **HJR 6: English as Idaho 's official language.

**This adds English to the Idaho Constitution as our official language. Government meetings, documents, court proceedings, and public school instruction would be in English, except where federal law requires otherwise. Right now it's only in statute, and a future legislature could repeal it.

**I 'm voting: YES.**

I sponsored this bill in the Senate because a common language is what makes us one people. Go to Los Angeles County and you'll find election materials printed in more than a dozen languages. That's what it looks like when a state stops expecting newcomers to learn its language and join it. This costs almost nothing and sets a clear expectation: if you come here, learn English and become an Idahoan. And it shouldn't depend on whoever controls the Legislature in a given year.

Putting it in the Constitution means it stays put.
* * *
3. **Proposition 1: The abortion "reproductive freedom" initiative.

**This creates a right to abortion up to fetal viability, and after viability under a broad "medical emergency" definition that reaches a woman's health as well as her life. It adds a "right of privacy" over reproductive decisions and requires any restriction to be "narrowly tailored" to the patient's health. It also shields providers and anyone who "assists" from penalties. It would overturn Idaho's current pro-life law.
**
I 'm voting: NO.**

This is WORSE than California's abortion law.

Abortion up to viability, a "health" exception broad enough to cover almost anything after that, and a "right of privacy" judges can stretch as far as they like (that's exactly how Montana's courts got there). "Narrowly tailored" is courtroom language, and it's there so judges can strike down limits Idaho passes. That could put things like parental consent for minors in front of a judge.

Idaho is one of the few states in the West that still protects unborn children. We made that choice through the people we elected. Prop 1 hands it to the courts and would make us LEFT of California.

Vote NO.
* * *

That's where I stand on those things.

I don't care (and I suspect you don't either) about the state gun. Pick whatever you want.
Make a plan to vote by November 3, and forward this to a neighbor who hasn't flipped their ballot over yet. And make sure you get your family and friends to vote. This whole low turnout thing is starting to wear on me.
Cheers,
Brian

Dear Peter,
---
“Wonderstruck” is the word that comes to mind when I remember my first experience among the redwoods. I’ll never forget seeing my family’s land in Humboldt County for the first time after traveling all the way from the east coast. Standing beneath that towering canopy, looking up at some of the tallest trees on Earth, I felt both small and connected at the same time. That feeling of wonder has never left me. Even today, after a lifetime spent among the redwoods, I still cannot believe how lucky I am to have spent some of the best days of my life in the presence of these ancient giants. My deep love for the redwoods is what led me to Save the Redwoods League. In 1982, I became a donor, and I’ve been a member ever since. Today, I’m honored to serve as a Save the Redwoods Councilor. What I didn’t quite expect all those years ago when I made my first gift was how meaningful it would feel. **It has become one of the great joys of my life to be part of this community that is keeping the redwood forests vibrant,** so that future generations can experience and enjoy these forests just as I have. That is why I’m asking you to join me today. clean_body: Turn your love for the redwoods into something lasting| | | | | | Dear Peter, “Wonderstruck” is the word that comes to mind when I remember my first experience among the redwoods. I’ll never forget seeing my family’s land in Humboldt County for the first time after traveling all the way from the east coast. Standing beneath that towering canopy, looking up at some of the tallest trees on Earth, I felt both small and connected at the same time. That feeling of wonder has never left me. Even today, after a lifetime spent among the redwoods, I still cannot believe how lucky I am to have spent some of the best days of my life in the presence of these ancient giants. My deep love for the redwoods is what led me to Save the Redwoods League. In 1982, I became a donor, and I’ve been a member ever since. Today, I’m honored to serve as a Save the Redwoods Councilor. What I didn’t quite expect all those years ago when I made my first gift was how meaningful it would feel. It has become one of the great joys of my life to be part of this community that is keeping the redwood forests vibrant, so that future generations can experience and enjoy these forests just as I have. That is why I’m asking you to join me today. Right from the start, your monthly support will go even further to help revive the range and connect more people to these incredible places. Thank you for standing with me and with the redwoods. | | | | | With gratitude, Peggy Light Save the Redwoods Councilor | | | Help restore and protect the redwoods | | | Save the Redwoods League 220 Montgomery St, Suite 350San Francisco, CA 94104United States CONNECT WITH US | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- |

# A Stark Contrast in Walla Walla
---

| | Last week I had my second debate with my opponent, this time down in Walla Walla on the Whitman campus. AAUW and Northwest Public Broadcasting put the forum together, and I laid out exactly what this fight is about: do we want safe communities, lower taxes, small government and more individual freedom - or higher taxes, a ballooning federal government and men competing in women’s sports? I already shared my opponent’s promise to “behead” and “dismember” the Department that not only protects us from terrorist threats, but that handles disaster relief. The contrast could not be been clearer, and neither could the stakes.
Ballots are dropping in a couple of weeks. If you care about Eastern Washington staying affordable, secure, and heard in Congress, I need you with me now. Talk to your neighbors, mail in your ballots, show up, and make sure we finish what we started!

Peter,
This is Sheriff Mike Bouchard but today, I’m writing to you simply as a father.
I’ve spent decades serving our community in law enforcement. I’ve seen crisis, loss, sacrifice.
I’ve watched families get that knock on the door no parent ever wants.
And when my son Mike chose to serve this country, I knew exactly what that decision meant.
I knew he would be putting his life on the line.
I knew our family would live with the quiet fear only military families truly understand.
And I knew there was a chance he might not come home.
But like every patriotic soldier, he didn’t hesitate.
**That’s who Mike has always been — even as a kid.**
He ran toward responsibility, toward challenges, toward the hard things that build a man’s character.
And over the last decade, I watched him serve in ways that made me both proud and humbled as his father:
_I watched him jump out of planes as a paratrooper._
_I watched him deploy to Iraq and live under constant threat — rockets, drones, militias._
_I watched him lead missions that protected thousands of American troops._
_I watched him volunteer to go back with only 20 days’ notice._
And when he walked off that plane after nine months in a combat zone... he didn’t talk about what he endured.
He talked about what our country needed.
That’s when I knew his mission wasn’t finished.
Mike stepped into this race for Congress because he sees the same danger here at home that he saw overseas: weakness, division, and leaders who have forgotten what service means.
But he’s stepping in late — because he was serving his country.
And that means he is now facing the toughest moment of any campaign: **his end-of-month deadline — the one that determines whether this mission survives.**
As someone who has spent his life in public service, I can tell you: early numbers matter. They tell the political world whether a candidate has real support... or whether they can be dismissed before the fight even begins.
**From one father, one patriot, to another — I am asking you to support my son tonight using the secure link below.** **Please, chip in $10, $25, or anything you can:**[**https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-michael-bouchard-inc/donate**](http://links.mikebouchardforcongress.com/u/click?_t=bb25c0b583c5471786d790f5e4203cc0&_m=1ba3a6a878aa40c1a619261f22bfefd4&_e=5qctD8Om7QNXpzTISMHifgzMH4gJtfcNulh6-2MkaeN2UwoXOpEd4xqbUkVGuvZLd-ZakfoKya8Ia0ybD481zu6WFNk_xWbHLNoTT-qu1owWz70tgSOBoCU1swPs52jg1du2wf36Igoai3TjVGwl-tB-5J4Yg-A0SVYtqRYzZk8xvH3q7cPPQtxPsuBFYDMzFKP6L0xG0b8tJ046Rard1uL3AI-hq3P38YagrVAWHysNcoNWRpmk5TkJSNmnQLfYdsWAnexXYHU3A7qtr8K77zuhDP81cbIxNAEb_x7x9UaJpwimSsfARfBx8XhHm1YTy_wFlFGdv6cNn-0RPWRqDlOET1u5vskbOIOVxiHtNdRspjJOWqRJqqLUGpwHUjCHuyA-mf5SugcVYsCKD3dUkr-0fbDw2N0rbIALJOlk8EEvsjHJMcTFMwnmyzOgRUp2f0lwLBaozg-Ku5qf1A9PUQ69pcqJhJCQsC2FerfOXkiWh30OdtrfwixzwxAiQgck7eSzGu79MfZeFUMzsTWTdtXWAgA1m-UppTnDDOLWQ97eVM2CWeS9Oqaw_T4zny6evrzZ5vJOzUZQNkUQaAOlxygVwHumK3dfr1GIPv0aUdk%3D)
---
Mike doesn’t quit. He doesn’t back down.
He has spent his life protecting others.
Now he wants to protect this community — and this country.
But he cannot win this fight without people like you standing with him.
Thank you for reading this. It means more to me than you know.
With respect,

Sheriff Michael Bouchard
Proud father of Captain Mike Bouchard
