clean_body: | = Tomorrow marks a key fundraising deadline. If your inbox is like mine, you’re seeing a lot of emails from candidates like me asking you to chip in before September ends. I’ve said this before, but asking for contributions from supporters like you is my least favorite part of the job. = | = I know it seems strange: How can just a few dollars make an impact in a toss-up race like mine? If everyone reading this email chipped what they could, we would instantly hit our online fundraising goal. Not only would we be better prepared for the attacks to come, we would send an unmistakable message of our grassroots strength in this race. I flipped this seat from red to blue in one of the closest races in the country two years ago – we won by 653 votes. It showed me just how important every vote, and every person, is to our movement. I’m fighting hard in Congress to deliver for CA-45 and beyond, but I’ll be frank: Without a Democratic majority, it’s extremely difficult to hold this administration accountable. We recently learned that the U.S. Postal Service is secretly following Trump’s plan to block millions of mail-in ballots this fall — in defiance of several court orders telling them to stop. I want to be direct with you about what this really is. It’s not a bureaucratic mess. It’s not a technical glitch. **This is a poison Donald Trump has been feeding the American people for years: make voters doubt whether their vote will even count.** He and his allies have worked long and hard to cast doubt on our elections — because a public that distrusts its own elections is easier to control than one that shows up and makes their voices heard at the ballot box. I've spent my career standing up to people who tried to bury the truth for political gain, and I can tell you: the greatest threat to this democracy right now isn't coming from outside our borders. _It's coming from a president who grows more powerful when we stop believing our votes matter._ **There is only one antidote strong enough to counter that threat: turnout so large and so overwhelming that no purged list or rigged voting system can suppress it.** That is the movement we’re building. Seat by seat, state by state. And there is no question that it requires each and every one of us to step up. **[Your gift today will help us turn out votes for Democrats across the country. T minus 5 Tuesdays til Election Day.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
This is it, Peter.
Today we're exactly 5 weeks out from Election Day. **Five weeks is all we have left to take Texas back, and what we do with them will decide this race.**
Right now, we're putting every resource we have to work: ads on the air, organizers knocking doors and making calls, and me on the road reaching as many Texans as I possibly can.
Just this past Sunday, I drove from North Texas all the way down to Central Texas. If you know how massive this state is, you know that isn’t exactly a short drive. But every mile is worth it when I get to meet supporters face to face and share our vision for the future of Texas.
Here's the hard truth: none of that runs on hope alone. Every ad slot, every organizer's shift, and every mile on the road has to be paid for. **And the decisions about what we can afford through Election Day are being made right now.**
That's why a recurring gift matters so much at this point in the race. When we know support is coming in every week, we can lock in ad time, keep organizers in the field, and plan our final push with confidence, instead of guessing what we'll be able to afford next week.
Your weekly donation from now until Election Day on November 3rd will be the steady fuel this campaign needs to make it to the finish line.

Gina

Peter, Republicans were hoping that the Supreme Court’s gutting of the Voting Rights Act and the frenzy of racial gerrymandering across the South would all but guarantee their victory in the midterms. Voters are saying not so fast. Just look at Georgia. Despite being outspent 9 to 1 by her Republican opponent, polls show that Democracy Defender Keisha Lance Bottoms is within striking distance in the governor’s race. This is no fluke. In Georgia, North Carolina, and Alabama — some of the states where the GOP has tried to tilt the midterms in their favor — voters have shown up to the polls in record numbers during the Democratic primaries. The people are sending a clear message: Republican attempts to restrict access to the ballot box have them fired up to vote! That’s why the NDRC doesn’t stop organizing after a gerrymander gets passed. The fight is only beginning — and holding anti-democracy lawmakers accountable at the ballot box is essential to our long-term strategy. Early voting is already underway in some states — and it begins on October 13 in Georgia. We’re optimistic that Keisha Lance Bottoms can flip that critical governorship — and we’re investing in over 300 Democracy Defenders across the country. Now it’s a sprint to Election Day. The people are sending a clear message: Republican attempts to restrict access to the ballot box have them fired up to vote! Early voting is already underway in some states — and it begins on October 13 in Georgia. After Kabul fell on August 15, 2021, The International Institute of St. Louis stood up a multi-nonprofit Refugee Command Center. By December 8, 2021, more than 300 Afghan evacuees had arrived, and CEO Arrey Obenson told St. Louis Public Radio that the federal stipend IISTL receives for each refugee -- $1,025 -- would not be spent on hotel stays. That stipend is the State Department's per-capita Reception & Placement payment -- taxpayer money on day one.
In November 2021, IISTL received a $1.5 million grant -- STLPR called the giver the Pershing Charitable Trust; NPR photo captions identify it as the Pershing Square Foundation -- to help settle Afghans.
On January 12, 2022, Schlichter held a press conference at the Institute in Tower Grove East announcing the **Afghan Resettlement Initiative** : a fully funded multi prong program to resettle Afghan refugees in St. Louis, backed by more than $1 million in donations and 800+ volunteers, with an initial target of relocating about 1,000 people. The pitch had two audiences: Afghans already here, and the federal government -- KSDK reported the plan explicitly aimed to market St. Louis to current Afghan refugees and the federal government in charge, with the St. Louis Economic Development Partnership noting 1,000 would be the _minimum_ sought through the program for Afghans who aided the war effort. St. Louis's motive was stated openly: reverse decades of population decline.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cc066c6a-8ec6-444b-831a-52eae13c53b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**The offer itself: rent, deposit, utilities, gift cards**
The program's public-facing site, afghancenter.org ("Why St. Louis?"), lays out the package for Afghan families -- including families relocated to St. Louis, Missouri, from other states -- under Transportation and Financial Support:
\- **Rent Assistance** : Covers up to three months of rent and one security deposit (with a rental limit).
\- **Gift Cards** : Provided to each person in the family each month until food stamps are approved...

After Kabul fell on August 15, 2021, The International Institute of St. Louis stood up a multi-nonprofit Refugee Command Center. By December 8, 2021, more than 300 Afghan evacuees had arrived, and CEO Arrey Obenson told St. Louis Public Radio that the federal stipend IISTL receives for each refugee -- $1,025 -- would not be spent on hotel stays. That stipend is the State Department's per-capita Reception & Placement payment -- taxpayer money on day one.
In November 2021, IISTL received a $1.5 million grant -- STLPR called the giver the Pershing Charitable Trust; NPR photo captions identify it as the Pershing Square Foundation -- to help settle Afghans.
On January 12, 2022, Schlichter held a press conference at the Institute in Tower Grove East announcing the **Afghan Resettlement Initiative** : a fully funded multi prong program to resettle Afghan refugees in St. Louis, backed by more than $1 million in donations and 800+ volunteers, with an initial target of relocating about 1,000 people. The pitch had two audiences: Afghans already here, and the federal government -- KSDK reported the plan explicitly aimed to market St. Louis to current Afghan refugees and the federal government in charge, with the St. Louis Economic Development Partnership noting 1,000 would be the _minimum_ sought through the program for Afghans who aided the war effort. St. Louis's motive was stated openly: reverse decades of population decline.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cc066c6a-8ec6-444b-831a-52eae13c53b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**The offer itself: rent, deposit, utilities, gift cards**
The program's public-facing site, afghancenter.org ("Why St. Louis?"), lays out the package for Afghan families -- including families relocated to St. Louis, Missouri, from other states -- under Transportation and Financial Support:
\- **Rent Assistance** : Covers up to three months of rent and one security deposit (with a rental limit).
\- **Gift Cards** : Provided to each person in the family each month until food stamps are approved.
\- Applications run through a WhatsApp line: +1 (314) 403-3530.
A compilation circulating on X in 2026 summarizes the same package -- three months' free rent, security deposit, utility coverage, and grocery gift cards -- and attributes it to the Schlichter-funded program:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a1fbf241-efde-4016-ae40-f8d726fe6dc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Two points: the rent aid is capped (three months, one deposit, "with a rental limit" -- not open-ended free rent), and the gift cards are designed to stop once SNAP kicks in -- i.e., the program bridges families onto federal food assistance, which is itself taxpayer-funded. St. Louis PR's December 2022 reporting confirms the Afghan Community Support Program created last year helped new arrivals pay rent for three months.
The Institute's August 2026 newsletter, Afghan Journal, still headlines the offer on its front pages:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/34a7581d-59ec-4408-8b86-9a03b347a38a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**The taxpayer layer**
Here's the anatomy of public vs. private money:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/91af56f7-020e-404c-8e0c-a25ffc173695?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The table circulating on X purports to show IISTL's federal grant actions -- base grants, expansion supplements, and additional increases from late 2025 through September 2026:
I have not independently verified the amounts -- the underlying grants should be pullable from USAspending.gov / TAGGS by searching International Institute of Metropolitan St. Louis. The KSDK file photo below (Feb. 2025) also shows the Institute's own signage referencing federal funding of its resettlement work.
**The recruitment machine: secondary migration, by design**
In August 2023, STLPR reported: The International Institute is touring the country to lure Afghans to St. Louis. Program directors traveled to Texas, Washington, California, New York, Tennessee, Maryland, Virginia, Colorado, Illinois and Washington, D.C., pitching at mosques and community centers. A Spectrum News piece the same fall: "Afghan Support Program tours nation in hopes of drawing refugees to St. Louis." Schlichter himself joined a delegation to Albania to pitch the region to Afghan refugees stranded there (St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Oct. 2023 -- the same article identifies him as sponsor of the Afghan Support program).
The results were celebrated openly by IISTL CEO Arrey Obenson (PBS NewsHour):
"As a result of this program, we have begun to see what we call secondary migration -- Afghans who came to the United States were designated to other communities and are now moving to St. Louis... So far they've seen more than 200 new arrivals."
Program manager Moji Sidiqi, 2023: "Our job is to position St. Louis as a space where there are resources and a place where they can succeed, but it is incumbent on the individual to have the mindset of working hard enough..." All of this is lawful -- refugees already admitted by the federal government have a constitutional right to live wherever they want, and states actively recruit residents. The controversy is the incentive structure, not the legality.
**Outcomes and the Move2STL generalization**
\- Scale: ~300 Afghans (Dec 2021) -> 1,150 total newcomers planned for 2023 -> ~6,000 Afghans settled in St. Louis by March 2026 (St. Louis Magazine).
\- Infrastructure: Afghan Community Center opened Feb. 2023; Afghan Chamber of Commerce announced Dec. 2022; The Afghan Journal newspaper; "Afghans Welcome Here" branding.
\- Business grants: first $15,000 Afghan Entrepreneurship Grant (Mohammed Raza Hassani, Oct. 2023), later $20,000 grants backed by Schlichter Bogard -- award ceremony July 14, 2026; a new cohort's application deadline was September 20, 2026. Winners include the Agrippa restaurant and Raz automotive.
\- The model went mainstream: On February 24, 2026, IISTL publicly launched Move2STL -- a free, job-first relocation concierge recruiting people from across the country, targeting U.S. citizens and green-card holders, explicitly to reverse St. Louis population decline. The flyer version advertises the same benefit stack -- free rent and security-deposit assistance -- now for anyone:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8b33a82d-de62-4924-8728-aab2af794c81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

**Caveats**
1\. Free rent is capped -- _up to_ three months, one deposit, with a rental limit.
2\. The gift cards hand off to federal benefits -- they stop when SNAP starts. The taxpayer connection is real but structural (ORR grants + $1,025/head stipend + SNAP endpoint)
3\. The direct incentives are philanthropy-funded -- Schlichter and the Pershing grant. The federal money funds IISTL's resettlement operations and the benefits being bridged into.
4\. The Pershing entity name is inconsistently rendered across sources -- verify before naming it.
5\. The viral X funding table (2025-26 federal supplements) is unverified
6\. Secondary migration is legal and explicitly celebrated by the program's own CEO
**Key sources**
\- STLPR, Jan. 12, 2022 -- Schlichter presser, "fully funded" initiative, $1.5M Pershing grant: stlpr.org/2022-01-12
\- AP (via LA Times/The Hill), May 7, 2022 -- ">$1M in donations, 800+ volunteers, Schlichter organizer and major funder"
\- STLPR, Dec. 23, 2022 -- Afghan Community Support Program pays 3 months' rent
\- STLPR, Aug. 23, 2023 -- national tour to "lure Afghans"; cities listed
\- PBS NewsHour -- Obenson "secondary migration" quote; 200+ arrivals
\- Spectrum, Oct. 13, 2023 -- tour continuing; community center classes
\- St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Oct. 2023 -- Albania trip; Hassani first grant; Schlichter "sponsor"
\- afghancenter.org/why-st-louis -- the offer language, verbatim
\- St. Louis Magazine, Mar. 2026 -- 6,000 Afghans; $20K grants; Schlichter Bogard backing
\- First Alert 4/KMOV, Feb. 24, 2026 -- Move2STL launch
\- USAspending/TAGGS -- ORR grant 90RG0209 ($1.2M, 9/30/21)

Outcomes and the Move2STL generalization \- Scale: ~300 Afghans (Dec 2021) -> 1,150 total newcomers planned for 2023 -> ~6,000 Afghans settled in St. Louis by March 2026 (St. Louis Magazine). \- Infrastructure: Afghan Community Center opened Feb. 2023; Afghan Chamber of Commerce announced Dec. 2022; The Afghan Journal newspaper; "Afghans Welcome Here" branding. \- Business grants: first $15,000 Afghan Entrepreneurship Grant (Mohammed Raza Hassani, Oct. 2023), later $20,000 grants backed by Schlichter Bogard -- award ceremony July 14, 2026; a new cohort's application deadline was September 20, 2026. Winners include the Agrippa restaurant and Raz automotive. \- The model went mainstream: On February 24, 2026, IISTL publicly launched Move2STL -- a free, job-first relocation concierge recruiting people from across the country, targeting U.S. citizens and green-card holders, explicitly to reverse St. Louis population decline. The flyer version advertises the same benefit stack -- free rent and security-deposit assistance -- now for anyone: | | ---|---|--- Thanks for reading! This post is public so feel free to share it. Caveats 1\. Free rent is capped -- up to three months, one deposit, with a rental limit. 2\. The gift cards hand off to federal benefits -- they stop when SNAP starts. The taxpayer connection is real but structural (ORR grants + $1,025/head stipend + SNAP endpoint) 3\. The direct incentives are philanthropy-funded -- Schlichter and the Pershing grant. The federal money funds IISTL's resettlement operations and the benefits being bridged into. 4\. The Pershing entity name is inconsistently rendered across sources -- verify before naming it. 5\. The viral X funding table (2025-26 federal supplements) is unverified 6\. Secondary migration is legal and explicitly celebrated by the program's own CEO Key sources \- STLPR, Jan. 12, 2022 -- Schlichter presser, "fully funded" initiative, $1.5M Pershing grant: stlpr.org/2022-01-12 \- AP (via LA Times/The Hill), May 7, 2022 -- ">$1M in donations, 800+ volunteers, Schlichter organizer and major funder" \- STLPR, Dec. 23, 2022 -- Afghan Community Support Program pays 3 months' rent \- STLPR, Aug. 23, 2023 -- national tour to "lure Afghans"; cities listed \- PBS NewsHour -- Obenson "secondary migration" quote; 200+ arrivals \- Spectrum, Oct. 13, 2023 -- tour continuing; community center classes \- St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Oct. 2023 -- Albania trip; Hassani first grant; Schlichter "sponsor" \- afghancenter.org/why-st-louis -- the offer language, verbatim \- St. Louis Magazine, Mar. 2026 -- 6,000 Afghans; $20K grants; Schlichter Bogard backing \- First Alert 4/KMOV, Feb. 24, 2026 -- Move2STL launch \- USAspending/TAGGS -- ORR grant 90RG0209 ($1.2M, 9/30/21) You're currently a free subscriber to . Short version: this is the most important fundraising deadline of our campaign, it closes tomorrow at midnight, and every dollar that comes in before then is still being MATCHED by some generous VA-02 supporters. Elaine ———— Forwarded message ———— From : Elaine Luria Date : Tues, 9/29 Subject : what happens after midnight tomorrow More than $5 million. That's how much Trump and his allies have already poured into Hampton Roads to keep Jen Kiggans in Congress. That means ads on every channel and mailers in every box. And there are still five weeks until Election Day. I've seen this movie before. In 2022, far-right groups spent $6,059,677 against me. This time they started earlier, and they're nowhere near done. So when people ask me why tomorrow's deadline matters so much, here's my answer: Tomorrow at midnight, we face our last FEC End-of-Quarter deadline before Election Day. After that, our fundraising report goes public. Our match offer is still ongoing,= | | = Reporters will use our report to tell voters whether this is still a Toss-Up or if it leans in one direction. name: Farewell President Trump
subject: In just 4 weeks, we might have to say goodbye to each other forever…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Never Surrender, Inc
body:
Do not make me say goodbye.
| | | |
# **FAREWELL TO TRUMP**
---
[](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
This was hard to write.
**_In just 4 weeks, we might have to say goodbye to each other forever..._**
That’s if we lose the Congressional Majority on Election Night.
On day 1, Democrats will file the Articles of Impeachment against me for the THIRD TIME. But this time, they will have the votes — the votes to lock me out of the White House and throw away the key.
**_Could you even begin to fathom MAGA without Trump??_**
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
Once they kick me out, they’ll reverse everything I’ve done to Make America Great Again over the past two years.
Borders will open and criminal illegal aliens will flood into our country AGAIN.
Cities like Washington DC will roar with crime AGAIN.
Social Security tax will go up to an all time high AGAIN.
And this time, the American dream might slip away for every young American and all future generations to come.
This will break my heart.
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
My job is far from over, and the last thing I want is for the Democrats to unleash terror on the great American people.
**_[So I am asking you, from the bottom of my heart, not to let them do it.](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)_**
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
You have stood with me when nobody else would. You have taken the hits, the insults, the lies, and you have never backed down. That’s why we’re still here. That’s why America still has a chance.
But four weeks is nothing. If our people sit this one out, it is over. No second chance. No do-over. They get the Majority, and they’ll obliterate all of the hard work that we’ve accomplished.
I need you in this fight. Not later. Now. One gift from you keeps our Majority alive and keeps me in this office, fighting for you.
Please. Do not make me say goodbye. Stand with me one more time. **__**
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)

body:
We are writing today to ask you to make a contribution to Elissa Slotkin's campaign committee.
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2512%2E135344%2EUJNpcF)

We are writing today to ask you to make a contribution to Elissa Slotkin's campaign committee before tomorrow's FEC deadline.
You may be asking, Elissa is not up for election right now – why are you asking me to contribute again?
First, it goes without saying that Elissa Slotkin won Michigan – and so did Donald Trump.
One of the reasons that happened is because we did better than typical Democrats in the "redder" parts of the state. That is something that has happened consistently in Elissa's previous elections. She might not win them outright, but she "loses better."
Here in Michigan, we have a bunch of big elections this November. Every statewide office is up – Governor, Secretary of State, Attorney General. We have an open Senate seat that we have to hold. The entire state senate and state house. And we have U.S. House races that could determine control of the chamber.
But even in other parts of the country, Elissa is getting a lot of requests to join Democrats in tough races campaign trail. And given the importance of this election, she wants to do everything she can to help in these final weeks.
That takes resources. We're not asking for a huge contribution today, just whatever you feel is worth it to help Democrats hold statewide offices, our other Senate seat, and to flip the House.
If lots and lots of people contribute, we can help Elissa play her part down the stretch.
[**Please use this link to contribute to Elissa Slotkin before our FEC deadline ends tomorrow night at midnight. Our average online donation is around $40. Many give more. Some give less. All that matters is that lots and lots of people are chipping-in to make sure Michigan is blue after the next election.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-26.79HKre&refcode=em260929-2&t=2&akid=2512%2E135344%2EUJNpcF)

Unlike Annie Andrews, I have had less than three months to build a grassroots campaign. She's had years running (unsuccessfully) for office.

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. **Trump Accounts**
My first daughter was born just months before the Big Beautiful Bill was signed. This entitled her to $1,000 in a Trump account. Why is this so meaningful? This account will be worth nearly $20,000 by the time she graduates high school, and I didn't have to spend a dime. **Abolished DEI from government**

name: Keisha Lance Bottoms
subject: I approved the ad buy
body:
There are moments in a campaign when waiting is the most expensive decision you can make.
This is one of them.
**This week, I authorized our campaign to begin placing a new major television ad, even though we haven't finished raising the money to cover the full buy.**
I don't love taking that kind of financial risk. But after my opponent, billionaire Rick Jackson, reserved $87 million in television advertising, I knew sitting on the sidelines wasn't an option.
**[Will you make a contribution today to Wes Moore and my campaign to help keep our new ad on the air and respond to Jackson's unprecedented spending?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260929-3.XZbLAd&refcode=em-20260929-3&t=1&akid=2019%2E1086043%2EtiDvK7)**
**[DONATE NOW››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260929-3.XZbLAd&amount=5&refcode=em-20260929-3&t=2&akid=2019%2E1086043%2EtiDvK7)**
Rick Jackson is betting that if he spends enough money, he can hide the fact that he got rich by profiting off our health care. He wants to hide the fact that he promised to be “Trump’s favorite Governor,” and that there’s not a single thing he disagrees with Trump on.
He's betting that an $87 million wall of television ads will drown out every volunteer, every organizer, every small-dollar donor, and every conversation about what's really at stake in this election.
**I'm betting he's wrong.**
But only if we have the resources to fight back.
That's why I instructed my team to start locking in our own TV reservations. Every day we wait, ad inventory becomes more expensive, more limited, and more valuable. If we're going to compete, we have to claim our place on the air now—not months from now.
It's a big commitment for a grassroots campaign. But this campaign has never been built on billionaire checks.
It's been built by people giving what they can because they believe Georgia deserves a governor who will fight for working families—not another wealthy executive trying to buy public office.
Rick Jackson may have $87 million reserved.
We have each other.
If thousands of people step up today, we can fund these ads, compete on the airwaves, and prove that Georgia's governor isn't for sale.

clean_body: There are moments in a campaign when waiting is the most expensive decision you can make. This is one of them. This week, I authorized our campaign to begin placing a new major television ad, even though we haven't finished raising the money to cover the full buy. I don't love taking that kind of financial risk. But after my opponent, billionaire Rick Jackson, reserved $87 million in television advertising, I knew sitting on the sidelines wasn't an option. Rick Jackson is betting that if he spends enough money, he can hide the fact that he got rich by profiting off our health care. He wants to hide the fact that he promised to be “Trump’s favorite Governor,” and that there’s not a single thing he disagrees with Trump on. He's betting that an $87 million wall of television ads will drown out every volunteer, every organizer, every small-dollar donor, and every conversation about what's really at stake in this election. I'm betting he's wrong. But only if we have the resources to fight back. That's why I instructed my team to start locking in our own TV reservations. Every day we wait, ad inventory becomes more expensive, more limited, and more valuable. If we're going to compete, we have to claim our place on the air now—not months from now. It's a big commitment for a grassroots campaign. But this campaign has never been built on billionaire checks. It's been built by people giving what they can because they believe Georgia deserves a governor who will fight for working families—not another wealthy executive trying to buy public office. Rick Jackson may have $87 million reserved. We have each other. If thousands of people step up today, we can fund these ads, compete on the airwaves, and prove that Georgia's governor isn't for sale. Thank you, Keisha Lance Bottoms

subject: A heartfelt request...

body:
Eugene Vindman deserves your support.

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-sep26?refcode=em260929-av-2-ken-burns&refcode2=1142_3892029_ASHmMc&akid=1142%2E3892029%2EASHmMc)
---
Hi, it’s Ken Burns. I am coming to you with a heartfelt request:
[**If you, like me, are deeply concerned about the future of our democracy and the rising tide of extremism, I urge you to join me in supporting Eugene Vindman’s reelection campaign for Congress today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-sep26?refcode=em260929-av-2-ken-burns&refcode2=1142_3892029_ASHmMc&akid=1142%2E3892029%2EASHmMc)
As a filmmaker, my life’s work has been dedicated to capturing pivotal moments in American history — moments that have shaped our nation’s identity and spirit. I’ve documented our country navigating through its darkest hours and emerging stronger and understanding the profound consequences of these moments.
Throughout my career, I’ve seen our nation evolve in countless ways, but one constant remains: our democracy, the cornerstone of our republic, and the essence of what it means to be American.
Yet, at this very moment, our democracy faces an unprecedented challenge — a critical inflection point. We are at a juncture where our very rights and freedoms are threatened.
The stakes have never been higher. Our democracy stands at a crossroads — and this moment requires leaders who will unify our country in defense of the very fabric of our nation — no matter political party or affiliation. Eugene Vindman is one of those leaders.
I first met Eugene and Alex nearly 40 years ago, when I interviewed the Vindman twins and their grandmother for a documentary about the meaning of the Statue of Liberty. It was shortly after they fled Soviet Ukraine and sought refuge in the United States as children.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-sep26?refcode=em260929-av-2-ken-burns&refcode2=1142_3892029_ASHmMc&akid=1142%2E3892029%2EASHmMc)
Their father came to the U.S. with $759 in his pocket, three children, and a dream of giving them a better life. And through hard work and perseverance, they achieved just that.
Eugene’s story is the embodiment of the American dream. He is a Ukrainian immigrant, an Army Veteran, and a lifelong defender of our democracy. He’s a good man — one who has devoted himself to defending our country with courage, selflessness, and resilience, even at his own expense.
Eugene has never failed to hold our leaders accountable — no matter their party. But right now, not only is our government baselessly retaliating against him through an investigation aimed at removing him from Congress, but he is being attacked relentlessly by the far right, all because he has never failed to hold our leaders accountable.
We need to keep people like Eugene in Congress — leaders who continue to stand up for our democracy and represent the true spirit of America.
So it would mean a lot to me if you could support his reelection campaign today to help keep him fighting for us in the People’s House.
[**Can you please contribute $25 or whatever you can afford to Eugene Vindman’s campaign for Congress today? I am asking because it is critical.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-sep26?refcode=em260929-av-2-ken-burns&refcode2=1142_3892029_ASHmMc&akid=1142%2E3892029%2EASHmMc)

But in order to start fixing these Republican-made problems, we must win this seat and take back the House majority. = If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately by pressing a button below. = = = = = Our end-of-quarter deadline gives Republicans the opportunity to seize on any weak spots they see in our numbers. = Thank you, Rep. HI EVERYONE,

October is here this week, and we're kicking it off with a Week of Action to turnout Republicans across the state and help all of
our Republicans win!

Our ask this week is simple: get involved and bring someone with you.

All of you already have Right Insight. Just login with the email you received this message at. You will be emailed a 6-digit code.
Plug that in and you're ready to start making calls and knocking doors. Everything you need is in the app.

name: Team Scott
subject: We've Been Through a Lot Together. Now, Let's Finish the Job...
body:
|
---
| |
---
| **We've Been Through a Lot Together. Now, Let's Finish the Job**

Fellow Vermonters -- we’ve got something new for you... but first, some important context:

**It's true: Governor Scott has been in office for nearly 10 years. **

**The fact is, we've been through _a lot_ together with this Governor: **
* **A growing crisis of affordability: housing, taxes, energy, healthcare, all of which first motivated Governor Scott to run in 2016. **
* **A decades-long dominant Progressive-Democrat majority in Montpelier that prioritizes national political agendas over the needs of working-class and rural Vermonters (who they still think should pay more). **
* **A global pandemic and recovery. **
* **Consecutive years of catastrophic floods, cleanup, and recovery.**
* **And chaos from and disruption out of Washington.**

... just to name a few of the big ones.

**_As a result, Vermonters know Governor Phil Scott better than they have ever known another governor._**

Through it all, he has always been a moderate voice of reason for Vermont, and our nation. He is a humble listener, always learning and working to bridge differences of opinion while continuing to fight for affordability, and judging policies by their results and not the person or party that proposes them.

Many Vermonters are frustrated with Vermont's affordability crisis.

**_But here's the part our opponents always leave out: the Governor is frustrated too!_**

**No governor has fought harder to take on the failing policies of the past and make Vermont more affordable. No one expected the majority in Vermont's Legislature to defend obviously unaffordable policies for 10 years, or to double down on them with unnecessary tax hikes and more regulations when they had a supermajority that could ignore the Governor. **

As you know, the Legislature decides what gets taken up and what goes to the Governor. A governor can propose, sign, or veto, but the Legislature makes the laws.

Remember: The progressive-democrat coalition has had a majority in the Legislature for more than 30 years.

The 2024 election started to balance the composition of both chambers, but not nearly enough.

**Affordability has not improved. That’s why the Governor is asking you to keep pushing for balance in the Legislature by supporting candidates who will work with him to finish the job -- on housing, healthcare and energy costs, property taxes and public safety. **

Of course, who Vermont's governor is and what their core philosophies are matters a lot too. And it's not often that an unknown candidate emerges with a major party nomination for the highest office in the land. But that’s what happened this past summer when progressive Amanda Janoo narrowly defeated a mainstream Democrat in the Democratic Primary.

We've highlighted that the Progressive-Democrat coalition has controlled the Legislature for more than 30-years. And we believe we have a responsibility to make sure you know some of our opponents’ policy positions, things you should **Know Before You Vote.**

Over the coming days, we’ll share information we think voters have a right to know as they make their decisions. We will base this information on Amanda Janoo's own words and credible sources, so you can review the information and decide for yourself.

**First up: What would Amanda Janoo do as Commander-in-Chief of the Vermont National Guard? **

There's a clear choice in this election. We hope you'll help us reelect Governor Scott, and send him a more balanced Legislature, so he can finish the job.

**Help us today by chipping in $10, $20 or $50 so we can keep getting Governor Scott's message out.

\- Team Scott **
###

clean_body: Fair Fight needs our support to power their proven model of outreach, education, and voter protection | | | None of us want to wake up the morning after Election Day wondering if we could have done more. Over the next five weeks, we must generate massive voter turnout and make sure we can elect enough Democracy Champions to enough offices to turn back the tide on rising autocracy. That’s why I’m grateful that Fair Fight is strategically investing in critical races where they can thwart the MAGA takeover. But they need our support as they double down on their urgent Georgia Takes the House campaign to flip the State House from red to blue. I’ll be honest: there’s a real chance we could fall just short. We could gain nine seats instead of the required 10. We could lose by a miniscule margin. In 2024, one Georgia State House race got decided by just 48 votes. And new polling shows that voters still need to learn more about candidates Fair Fight has endorsed before we can get them over the finish line. = If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- If we miss this window to flip the Georgia State House, we might not have another chance for a long time. Enough seats are in play right now to get it done. But if Republicans hang onto control, even by just a sliver, they could ram through new rigged voting maps and inflate their majority through gerrymandering. With an iron grip on the General Assembly, Republicans could keep passing bills that shred voting rights and hurt working people. These elections aren’t about scoring political points. They’re about changing people's lives — making sure more people can send their kids to public schools with enough teachers and books, can go to the doctor without going broke, and can get relief from rising costs. The path to victory is realistic, but still uphill, and Fair Fight is counting on an increase in grassroots fundraising as they ramp up their proven model of outreach, education, and voter protection in these critical final weeks. = Thank you, Stacey Abrams P.S. clean_body: The Democrats are outspending us. Tomorrow night decides whether we can answer back. | Fellow Patriot - I recorded a quick video for you on the campaign trail. I wanted you to see what this campaign really looks like: folks in red shirts, yard signs in the grass, South Carolinians who got up early on a weekend because they believe in this fight. But I'll be straight with you about what we're up against. Radical Democrats nationwide have already sent over $20 million to my opponent. That money is coming in from liberal donors across the country who see this seat as their chance to flip South Carolina blue. They're spending it on TV ads and mailers, and they have an army of paid staff to push the most radical agenda ever put before South Carolina voters. We can't match them dollar for dollar.We don't have to. That's why tomorrow's midnight deadline matters so much. It's our end-of-quarter deadline. When the reports go public, the media, the pundits, and the Democrats will all look at them to decide whether this race is competitive. | | | Hi team, Mark Kelly here.

As you might know, I've served our country as a combat pilot and traveled into orbit as an astronaut at NASA. I'm a proud husband, father, and grandfather. And now, I'm a senator for Arizona and a Vice Chair for the DSCC.

I've been through a lot – and I've also learned a lot. **The biggest takeaway of all is this:_Be prepared._**

[**Which brings me to why I'm reaching out: Will you chip in $7 to the DSCC to make sure we have every resource on hand as we fight to flip the Senate blue?**](https://go.dscc.org/go/23346?amount=7&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=7&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-FD-20260930-MarkKelly-KellyPreparingForTheMissionFR-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20260930-MarkKelly-KellyPreparingForTheMissionFR-Pros-sl1&akid=26428%2E9716520%2Exs0Gz5)

Both are important and challenging – but they're also incredibly rewarding and fun.

The trick I've learned is to always head into the mission _ready to go_. Putting in the time, effort, research, practice, and whatever else it takes to be prepared. I don't like leaving anything up to chance. Not in outer space. Not on the playground.

It can mean the difference between success and failure, winning and losing, being a cool grandpa or not.

And the same is true of our team in this critical election.

Being prepared means all kinds of things to different people. But for _this team_ , it means gathering vital resources to help us put our plans into action.

* 1.4 points. Michigan is one of the seats that decides majority control
of the Senate, and a recent poll has Abdul trailing by 1.4 points.
Lose here, and the majority is virtually guaranteed for Republicans,
who will no doubt continue prioritizing Trump’s extreme agenda.

* $70 million. That's what Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and MAGA Super PACs
are spending to flip Michigan red. It's one of the largest efforts
we've seen to take down a Democratic Senate nominee.

* 0.3%. That's how much Senator Slotkin won Michigan by in 2024. This
seat gets decided by a rounding error, which is exactly why we have to
give this fight everyone we’ve got.

* 24 hours. That’s roughly how much time we have left until our last FEC
quarterly deadline of this election cycle. After tomorrow night,
everything we’ve raised will be visible for the MAGA donor network to
see.

Abdul has never taken a dime from corporate PACs, and he never will. The
only way we win this competitive, expensive race is if we band together
right now.
